  awb_number varchar [note: 'The unique air waybill number assigned to this consignment for air freight shipments. Format: 3-digit airline prefix followed by 8-digit serial number.']

  destination_postal_code varchar [note: 'The postal or ZIP code of the consignment destination location.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this consignment record was last updated or modified in the system.']
  lifecycle_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the consignment from booking through final delivery or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: booked|confirmed|in_transit|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled|returned|exception — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

  origin_address_line1 varchar [note: 'The first line of the pickup or origin address for the consignment.']

  origin_country_code varchar [note: 'The three-letter ISO country code for the consignment origin country.']

  service_type varchar [note: 'The type of logistics service provided for this consignment: express parcel delivery, air freight, ocean freight, road freight, rail freight, or cross-border shipping.']
  shipper_contact_phone varchar [note: 'The contact phone number for the shipper or sender.']
  shipper_name varchar [note: 'The full name of the shipper or sender of the consignment.']
  sla_source varchar [note: 'The source of the service level commitment: customer contract, published rate card, spot booking, or standard terms.']
  special_handling_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes describing any special handling requirements, access instructions, or delivery preferences for the consignment.']
  transit_time_days varchar [note: 'The committed or expected transit time for the consignment from origin to destination, measured in days.']
  un_number varchar [note: 'The four-digit UN number identifying the dangerous goods classification if the consignment contains hazardous materials.']
  volume_cbm decimal(10,3) [note: 'The total volume of the consignment measured in cubic meters.']
  volumetric_weight_kg decimal(10,2) [note: 'The dimensional or volumetric weight calculated based on the consignment dimensions, used for pricing when it exceeds actual weight.']

  Note: 'Core master entity representing a shipment booking/consignment record — the primary business object in the shipment domain. Captures the full lifecycle identity of a shipment from booking through final delivery, including service type (express parcel, freight, cross-border), origin/destination, declared weight, volumetric/DIM weight, CBM, number of pieces, incoterms code, COD flag, DDP/DAP/FOB terms, booking channel, booking date, committed SLA type, committed delivery date, transit time commitment, SLA source (customer contract/rate card/spot booking), priority level, delivery instructions (instruction type, preferred time window, special access notes, safe place, alternative address, contact phone), current lifecycle status, and OTD/OTIF target. Serves as the anchor entity integrating SAP TM freight orders, Oracle TMS shipment execution records, and FourKites visibility events. SSOT for shipment identity and service commitment across the enterprise.'
}

  shipment_leg_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to shipment.shipment_leg. Business justification: Tracking events occur during specific transport legs of a shipment\'s journey. Adding shipment_leg_id allows precise attribution of scan events to transport segments (e.g., \'departed origin\' is end of ']
  transport_asset_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the vehicle, truck, aircraft, or vessel involved in the event. Used for fleet management and route optimization. Nullable for stationary hub events.']
  actual_delivery_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Actual date and time of final delivery to consignee. Only populated for DELIVERED event types. Used for OTD (On-Time Delivery) and OTIF (On-Time In-Full) KPI calculation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  api_transaction_reference varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the API call or transaction that created this event record. Used for API audit trail and troubleshooting. Nullable for non-API events.']

  container_number varchar [note: 'ISO container number for ocean freight shipments. Format: 4-letter owner code + 6-digit serial number + check digit. Only populated for containerized freight events.']

  damage_reported boolean [note: 'Indicates whether damage to the shipment was observed and reported during this event. True if damage detected, False otherwise. Triggers claims workflow.']

  event_type_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code representing the specific event type. Examples: PICKUP, DEPARTED, ARRIVED, IN_TRANSIT, SORTED, LOADED_OUTBOUND, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, EXCEPTION_DELAY, EXCEPTION_DAMAGE, STATUS_CHANGE. Aligns with IATA and carrier EDI standards.']
  exception_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating the root cause of the exception. Examples: WEATHER_DELAY, CUSTOMS_HOLD, ADDRESS_INCORRECT, DAMAGE_IN_TRANSIT, REFUSED_BY_CONSIGNEE. Only populated for exception events.']

  exception_resolution_status varchar [note: 'Current resolution state of the exception. Only populated for exception events. Tracks whether the issue has been addressed.']
  exception_resolution_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the exception was resolved. Only populated for exception events that have been closed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  exception_severity varchar [note: 'Severity level of the exception event. Only populated for event_category = exception. Low: minor delay; Medium: moderate delay or documentation issue; High: significant delay or damage; Critical: shipment at risk or lost.']
  facility_code varchar [note: 'Internal code identifying the facility, hub, sortation center, or warehouse where the event occurred. Nullable for in-transit or external carrier events.']
  gps_latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic latitude coordinate of the event location in decimal degrees. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000. Captured from GPS-enabled devices or FourKites real-time tracking.']
  gps_longitude decimal(11,7) [note: 'Geographic longitude coordinate of the event location in decimal degrees. Range: -180.0000000 to +180.0000000. Captured from GPS-enabled devices or FourKites real-time tracking.']

  location_city varchar [note: 'City name where the tracking event occurred. Used for customer visibility and geographic analytics.']

  new_status varchar [note: 'The shipment status after this lifecycle event. Only populated for event_category = lifecycle. Represents the state transition target.']
  pieces_count varchar [note: 'Number of pieces, packages, or handling units scanned or processed in this event. Used for piece-level tracking and inventory reconciliation.']
  pod_image_url varchar [note: 'URL or storage path to the scanned or photographed proof of delivery document. Used for audit and claims resolution.']

  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this tracking event record was first inserted into the data platform. Immutable. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Distinct from event_timestamp which is the business event time.']
  record_source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the operational system that originally created this event record. Examples: SAP TM, Oracle TMS, Manhattan WMS, FourKites, carrier EDI gateway. Used for data lineage and quality assessment.']
  scan_type varchar [note: 'Method used to capture the tracking event. Barcode: handheld or fixed scanner; RFID: radio frequency identification; Manual: keyboard entry; OCR: optical character recognition.']
  seal_number varchar [note: 'Security seal number applied to container or trailer. Used for customs compliance and tamper detection. Recorded at sealing and verified at unsealing events.']
  temperature_celsius decimal(5,2) [note: 'Ambient or cargo temperature recorded at the time of the event, in degrees Celsius. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance. Nullable for non-temperature-controlled shipments.']
  weight_kg decimal(12,3) [note: 'Actual or verified weight of the shipment at the time of the event, in kilograms. May differ from booking weight. Used for weight reconciliation and billing adjustments.']

  Note: 'Immutable, append-only record of any shipment event captured throughout the shipment lifecycle — including carrier-reported tracking milestones, internal hub/sortation operational events, exception/deviation events, and business lifecycle state transitions. Each event records the event category (tracking/hub_operation/exception/lifecycle), event type code (e.g., PICKUP, DEPARTED, ARRIVED, SORTED, LOADED_OUTBOUND, EXCEPTION_DELAY, STATUS_CHANGE), event timestamp, location (facility code, city, country, GPS coordinates), event source (FourKites, carrier EDI, WMS scan, sortation system, TMS), operator ID, severity (for exceptions), resolution fields (for exceptions), previous/new status (for lifecycle transitions), and raw event description. Serves as the unified event log enabling OTD calculation, predictive ETA updates, exception detection, and full shipment audit trail. Never updated after insert.'

  delivery_exception_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating any exception or deviation from normal delivery process noted at the time of delivery (e.g., damaged package, partial delivery, refused).']
  delivery_latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'GPS latitude coordinate of the exact delivery location captured by the delivery agent\'s device at the time of delivery.']
  delivery_longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'GPS longitude coordinate of the exact delivery location captured by the delivery agent\'s device at the time of delivery.']
  delivery_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes entered by the delivery agent at the time of delivery. May include special instructions followed, access issues, or recipient comments.']
  delivery_postal_code varchar [note: 'Postal code or ZIP code of the delivery location.']
  delivery_state_province varchar [note: 'State, province, or region where the delivery was completed.']
  delivery_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The exact date and time when the shipment was delivered to the recipient. This is the principal business event timestamp for the POD transaction, distinct from audit timestamps.']
  delivery_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the delivery method used to complete the shipment handover. Indicates where and how the package was left.']
  device_code varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the mobile device or handheld scanner used by the delivery agent to capture the POD. Supports audit trail and device tracking.']
  dispute_raised_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator of whether the shipper or recipient has raised a dispute regarding this delivery or COD collection. True indicates an active or historical dispute.']
  dispute_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the reason for the delivery or COD dispute, if one was raised. Supports claims management and customer service resolution.']
  document_number varchar [note: 'External business identifier or document number for the POD record. May be printed on physical POD forms or referenced in customer communications.']
  epod_image_reference varchar [note: 'URI or storage path reference to the digital photograph of the delivered package taken at the delivery location. Supports ePOD standards for visual delivery confirmation.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this POD record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking for POD status updates or dispute resolution.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The payment instrument used by the recipient to settle the COD amount at delivery (e.g., cash, credit card, mobile wallet).']
  pod_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the POD record. Indicates whether the delivery evidence has been accepted by the shipper, is under dispute, or is pending verification.']
  recipient_contact_number varchar [note: 'Phone number of the recipient who accepted the delivery. Used for delivery confirmation and follow-up communication.']
  recipient_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the recipient who accepted the delivery. Used for sending electronic proof of delivery confirmation.']
  recipient_id_number varchar [note: 'Identification document number presented by the recipient at delivery. Captured for high-value shipments or regulatory compliance.']
  recipient_id_type varchar [note: 'Type of identification document presented by the recipient at delivery for high-value or restricted shipments.']
  recipient_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the person who received the shipment at the delivery location. This is the identity label for the receiving party.']
  recipient_signature varchar [note: 'Base64-encoded signature image or reference URI to the signature captured at delivery. Serves as biometric proof of receipt.']
  remittance_batch_number varchar [note: 'Identifier of the financial batch in which this COD collection was remitted to the shipper. Supports reconciliation and audit of COD settlements.']
  remittance_date date [note: 'The date on which the collected COD amount was remitted to the shipper. Used for financial settlement tracking and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance.']
  remittance_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the COD amount remittance back to the shipper. Tracks the financial settlement lifecycle from collection through to shipper payment.']
  transaction_reference_number varchar [note: 'External payment transaction reference number or receipt number for non-cash COD payments. Links POD to payment gateway or card processor transaction.']
  variance_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code explaining why the collected amount differs from the COD amount (e.g., partial payment, pricing dispute, damaged goods discount).']
  verification_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the POD record was verified or approved by operations or quality control staff.']

  Note: 'Proof of Delivery (POD / ePOD) record capturing evidence of successful shipment delivery and any Cash on Delivery (COD) collection at the point of delivery. Stores delivery timestamp, recipient name, recipient signature (base64 or reference URI), delivery location coordinates (GPS), delivery type (door/reception/locker/neighbour), ePOD image reference, delivery agent employee ID, device ID used for capture, delivery notes or exceptions noted at delivery, POD status (accepted/disputed/pending), COD amount, COD currency, payment method (cash/card/digital wallet), amount collected, collection timestamp, remittance status, and any variance between COD amount and collected amount. Aligns with ePOD standards and supports COD reconciliation, remittance tracking to shippers, claims management, and financial settlement. SSOT for delivery confirmation evidence and COD collection.'
}

  prediction_update_frequency_minutes varchar [note: 'Frequency in minutes at which the prediction is updated for this milestone. Varies based on transport mode, priority, and data availability (e.g., 15 minutes for air, 60 minutes for ocean).']

  sla_status varchar [note: 'Current SLA compliance status for this milestone. ON_TIME = predicted to meet commitment, AT_RISK = potential delay within threshold, DELAYED = predicted or actual breach of commitment, EARLY = predicted or actual early completion.']

  variance_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Variance in hours between the current predicted datetime and the original committed datetime. Positive values indicate delay (late), negative values indicate early arrival/departure. Used for SLA breach prediction and OTIF measurement.']
  vehicle_identifier varchar [note: 'Identifier for the specific vehicle, vessel, aircraft, or container handling this leg (e.g., flight number, vessel name, truck license plate, container number).']
  weather_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether adverse weather conditions are impacting or predicted to impact this milestone. True = weather impact detected, False = no weather impact.']

  Note: 'Stores planned and predicted ETA/ETD milestone records for each shipment leg and overall consignment. Captures milestone type (ETD_ORIGIN, ETA_TRANSIT_HUB, ETD_TRANSIT_HUB, ETA_DESTINATION, ETA_DELIVERY), original committed datetime, current predicted datetime, prediction source (FourKites AI, carrier EDI, manual override), prediction confidence score, variance in hours from original commitment, and last updated timestamp. Enables SLA breach prediction, proactive customer notification, and OTIF performance measurement. Sourced from FourKites predictive ETA engine.'
}

Table shipment.shipment_package {
  shipment_package_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the individual package or piece within a consignment. Primary key for the shipment package entity.']
  consignment_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent shipment or consignment that this package belongs to. Links the package to its master shipment record.']

  actual_weight_kg decimal(10,3) [note: 'Physical gross weight of the package measured in kilograms. Used for freight charge calculation, load planning, and carrier capacity management.']
  barcode_number varchar [note: 'Unique barcode or label number assigned to the package for scanning and tracking throughout the logistics network. Used for piece-level visibility and warehouse operations.']
  chargeable_weight_kg decimal(10,3) [note: 'The greater of actual weight or volumetric weight, used as the basis for freight charge calculation. Determines the billable weight for rating and invoicing.']
  contents_description varchar [note: 'Textual description of the declared contents within the package. Used for customs declarations, dangerous goods screening, and handling instructions.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this package record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  current_location_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the current physical location of the package (warehouse, hub, terminal, or in-transit vehicle). Updated by scan events for real-time visibility.']
  dangerous_goods_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the package contains dangerous goods (DG) requiring special handling, labeling, and regulatory compliance per IMDG or IATA DG regulations.']
  declared_value_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Monetary value declared by the shipper for the package contents. Used for insurance coverage, customs valuation, and liability limits.']
  declared_value_currency varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the declared value amount. Enables multi-currency valuation and customs reporting.']
  delivery_signature_name varchar [note: 'Name of the person who signed for the package upon delivery. Part of electronic proof of delivery (ePOD) record.']
  estimated_delivery_date date [note: 'Predicted date when the package will be delivered to the final consignee. Used for customer notifications and SLA monitoring.']

  source_system varchar [note: 'Name of the operational system that generated this hub event record. MANHATTAN_WMS: warehouse management system. SAP_TM: transportation management. SORTATION_SYSTEM: automated sortation equipment. HANDHELD_SCANNER: mobile scanning device. AUTOMATED_SORTER: high-speed sorter.']
  source_system_transaction_reference varchar [note: 'Unique transaction or event identifier from the source system, used for traceability and reconciliation back to the originating system.']
  special_handling_code varchar [note: 'Code indicating special handling requirements for the shipment during hub operations. FRAGILE: handle with care. PERISHABLE: time/temperature sensitive.   un_number varchar [note: 'Four-digit UN number identifying the hazardous material classification, applicable if hazmat_flag is True. Format: UN followed by 4 digits (e.g., UN1203).']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this hub event record was last modified in the data system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.']
  volume_cbm decimal(10,3) [note: 'Volume of the handling unit in cubic meters, captured during the hub event if dimensioning equipment is used.']
  weight_kg decimal(10,2) [note: 'Actual weight of the handling unit in kilograms, captured during the hub event if weigh-in-motion or scale scanning is performed.']

  Note: 'Records operational events at transit hubs and sorting facilities during a shipment\'s journey — including inbound scan, sortation, outbound loading, and transfer events. Captures hub facility code, event type (INBOUND_SCAN, SORTED, LOADED_OUTBOUND, TRANSFERRED, HELD, RETURNED_TO_SENDER), event timestamp, sort lane/belt assignment, outbound manifest reference, handling unit barcode, operator ID, and any hold reason code. Distinct from tracking_event (carrier-reported external events) — this captures internal hub operational processing events from WMS and sortation systems.'
}

Each record links one consignment to one accessorial charge with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific application: the actual charge amount applied (which may differ from catalog due to negotiations), quantity of units charged, application timestamp, waiver status, and approval requirements. This is a core operational entity in the billing domain, actively managed by rating engines, billing systems, and customer service teams processing disputes and waivers.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, a single consignment routinely incurs multiple accessorial charges simultaneously (residential delivery surcharge + liftgate fee + signature required + hazmat handling for the same shipment), and each accessorial charge definition (e.g., \'Residential Delivery Surcharge\') applies to thousands of consignments daily. The business actively manages these applications through rating engines, billing systems, customer service waiver processes, and dispute resolution workflows. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational entity that humans create (manual charge additions), update (waiver approvals), and query (\'show me all accessorials applied to consignment AWB12345\', \'which consignments had residential surcharges waived this month\').'
}

  weight_in_consolidation_kg decimal(10,2) [note: 'The weight in kilograms of this consignment\'s cargo that was allocated to this specific consolidation. Essential for pro-rata freight charge allocation when a consignment is split across multiple consolidations, and for accurate consolidation weight reconciliation.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the operational event of a consignment being physically loaded into a specific consolidation container or ULD. It captures the critical CFS warehouse operations data including the sequence in which cargo was loaded, precise entry and exit timestamps for deconsolidation planning, the number of handling units from this consignment in this specific consolidation, and the allocated weight for pro-rata freight charge calculation. Each record represents one consignment\'s participation in one consolidation, supporting NVOCC co-loading operations, CFS workflow management, and split-shipment tracking when a single consignment spans multiple consolidations.. Existence Justification: In LCL and freight forwarding operations, a single consignment can be physically split across multiple consolidations when it exceeds available capacity in one container/ULD, and each consolidation contains cargo from multiple different consignments. The business actively manages each consignment-consolidation pairing as a distinct operational event with specific loading sequence, entry/exit timestamps, and weight allocation for pro-rata freight billing. This is a core NVOCC business process managed by CFS operations teams.'
}

Table shipment.consignment_offset_allocation {
  consignment_offset_allocation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for this consignment-offset program allocation record. Primary key.']
  carbon_offset_program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the carbon offset program from which credits were allocated. Each allocation draws from exactly one program.']
  consignment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the consignment that received carbon offset allocation. Each allocation applies to exactly one consignment.']
  allocation_cost_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'The cost incurred by Transport Shipping for this offset allocation, calculated as offset_quantity_tco2e multiplied by the program price per tonne at allocation time. Used for financial reconciliation and P&L attribution.']
  allocation_date date [note: 'The date when the carbon offset credits were allocated to this consignment. Used for vintage tracking, compliance reporting, and financial reconciliation.']
  allocation_method varchar [note: 'The method by which offset credits were allocated to this consignment: automatic_portfolio (system-driven blended allocation), customer_requested (customer purchased carbon-neutral shipping), manual_override (sustainability team adjustment), compliance_mandate (CORSIA or regulatory requirement).']
  allocation_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes capturing additional context about this allocation: reason for manual override, customer special requests, compliance requirements, or audit annotations.']
  certificate_issue_date date [note: 'The date when the carbon offset certificate was issued to the customer for this allocation.']
  certificate_issued_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether a carbon offset certificate has been issued to the customer for this allocation. Used to track customer-facing deliverables and prevent duplicate issuance.']
  certificate_number varchar [note: 'The unique certificate number issued to the customer for this carbon offset allocation, if applicable. Links to certificate generation system.']
  created_by_user varchar [note: 'The user ID or system account that created this allocation record. Used for audit trails and accountability.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this allocation record was created in the system.']
  customer_charge_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'The amount charged to the customer for carbon-neutral shipping on this consignment, if customer_requested_flag is true. May differ from allocation_cost_usd due to pricing strategy.']
  customer_requested_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the customer explicitly requested and paid for carbon-neutral shipping for this consignment. Used for revenue attribution and customer reporting.']
  offset_quantity_tco2e decimal(18,4) [note: 'The quantity of carbon offset credits allocated from this program to this consignment, measured in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent. This is the core transactional attribute representing the actual offset applied.']
  registry_retirement_reference varchar [note: 'The unique retirement transaction identifier from the external carbon offset registry (e.g., Verra, Gold Standard). Provides audit trail and verification link.']
  retirement_date date [note: 'The date when the allocated offset credits were permanently retired in the carbon offset registry. Used for compliance reporting and audit trails.']
  retirement_status varchar [note: 'The lifecycle status of the allocated offset credits: allocated (reserved for this consignment), retired (permanently retired in registry), pending_retirement (awaiting registry confirmation), cancelled (allocation reversed).']

  Note: 'This association product represents the allocation of carbon offset credits from specific offset programs to individual consignments. It captures the operational process of applying carbon offset credits to shipments, supporting both automatic portfolio-based allocation and customer-requested carbon-neutral shipping. Each record links one consignment to one carbon offset program with the quantity of CO2e offset, allocation method, timing, and certificate issuance status. This enables Transport Shipping to track blended offset portfolios per shipment and provide customers with verifiable carbon-neutral delivery.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping\'s carbon offset operations, consignments are offset through multiple programs simultaneously using a portfolio approach (e.g., aviation CORSIA-eligible credits plus voluntary Gold Standard reforestation credits to meet both compliance and marketing goals). Conversely, each offset program covers many consignments over time as credits are allocated and retired. The business actively manages these allocations: sustainability teams select program mixes, calculate offset quantities per consignment based on weight/distance/mode, track retirement status in external registries, and issue certificates to customers who purchase carbon-neutral shipping.'
}

Table shipment.manifest_supplier_pickup {
  manifest_supplier_pickup_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for this manifest-supplier pickup record. Primary key.']
  freight_manifest_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the freight manifest that includes this supplier pickup stop']
  supplier_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the supplier location where pickup occurred']
  consignment_count varchar [note: 'Number of individual consignments (shipments) collected from this supplier for this manifest. Used for load reconciliation and supplier performance metrics.']
  pickup_sequence varchar [note: 'The ordinal position of this supplier in the milk run route sequence (1st stop, 2nd stop, etc.). Critical for route optimization and driver instructions.']
  pickup_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the pickup at this supplier location (scheduled, in_transit, completed, missed, cancelled). Tracks execution state for operational visibility.']
  pickup_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Actual date and time when the driver completed pickup at this supplier location. Used for on-time pickup performance tracking and route execution analysis.']
  planned_pickup_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Scheduled date and time for pickup at this supplier location as planned by the TMS route optimizer. Used to measure pickup punctuality.']
  volume_cbm decimal(15,3) [note: 'Total volume in cubic meters of all consignments picked up from this supplier for this manifest. Used for vehicle capacity utilization analysis.']
  weight_kg decimal(15,3) [note: 'Total weight in kilograms of all consignments picked up from this supplier for this manifest. Contributes to manifest total weight and vehicle load planning.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the pickup event between a freight manifest and a supplier in milk run consolidation operations. It captures the operational details of collecting consignments from a specific supplier location as part of a multi-stop manifest route. Each record links one freight manifest to one supplier with pickup-specific attributes including sequence order, volume collected, and timestamp. This enables milk run route optimization, supplier performance tracking, and load reconciliation by origin point.. Existence Justification: In milk run consolidation operations, a single freight manifest collects shipments from multiple supplier locations along a planned route (e.g., automotive parts from 5 suppliers in one truck run). Conversely, a single supplier has shipments picked up across multiple manifests over time (different days, different routes, different service lanes). The business actively manages pickup sequences, tracks per-supplier volumes on each manifest, and measures on-time pickup performance at each supplier stop.'
}

Table customer.account_hierarchy {
  account_hierarchy_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each account hierarchy relationship record in the Transport Shipping customer domain. Primary key for the account_hierarchy data product.']
  agreement_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the master contract or framework agreement governing the enterprise account hierarchy relationship. Links to the contract and agreement domain for SLA entitlements, pricing terms, and service scope.']
  child_account_customer_account_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the child (subsidiary, affiliate, or regional) account in the hierarchy. References the subordinate account linked to the parent for group-level management and revenue roll-up.']
  primary_customer_account_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the parent account in the hierarchy. References the account that sits one level above the child account, enabling enterprise roll-up for consolidated billing and group SLA management.']
  account_segment varchar [note: 'Business segmentation classification of the account hierarchy, reflecting the commercial tier of the enterprise group. Drives account management strategy, service prioritization, and sales coverage in Salesforce CRM.']
  aeo_status varchar [note: 'Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification status of the enterprise account group. AEO-certified accounts receive expedited customs clearance and reduced inspection rates. Managed in Descartes Customs global trade management.']
  annual_contracted_revenue decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total annual contracted revenue committed by the enterprise account group under the master agreement. Used for group-level P&L reporting, EBITDA analysis, and account tier classification in SAP S/4HANA Finance.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the account hierarchy relationship was formally approved by the designated authority. Supports SOX audit trail and change management governance.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee identifier of the Transport Shipping commercial or finance authority who approved the account hierarchy relationship. Required for SOX internal controls and audit trail compliance.']
  child_account_count varchar [note: 'Number of direct child accounts linked to the parent account at this hierarchy level. Provides a structural summary for account management and hierarchy governance without requiring recursive queries.']
  consolidation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the child account\'s shipment charges and invoices are consolidated into the parent account\'s billing statement. When true, enables group-level invoice generation and payment management in SAP S/4HANA Finance.']
  country_of_domicile varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the parent account\'s legal domicile. Determines applicable trade compliance regulations, customs requirements, and tax jurisdiction for the enterprise group.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the account hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record provenance and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  credit_consolidation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the child account\'s credit exposure is pooled with the parent account for group-level credit limit management. When true, credit checks in SAP S/4HANA Finance are evaluated at the parent account level.']
  credit_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum credit exposure approved for the enterprise account group at the parent hierarchy level. Applied when credit_consolidation_flag is true. Managed in SAP S/4HANA Finance credit management module.']
  crm_account_hierarchy_code varchar [note: 'Salesforce CRM system identifier for the account hierarchy record. Enables cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the Salesforce CRM source of record for account management and opportunity tracking.']
  ctpat_status varchar [note: 'C-TPAT certification status of the enterprise account group for US customs security compliance. Certified accounts benefit from reduced CBP examinations and expedited border processing. Managed in Descartes Customs.']
  data_privacy_region varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or region code indicating the primary data privacy jurisdiction applicable to the account hierarchy record. Determines GDPR, CCPA, or other regional data protection obligations for customer data handling.']
  denied_party_check_date date [note: 'Date on which the most recent denied party and sanctions screening was performed for the enterprise account group. Ensures compliance screening currency per regulatory requirements.']
  denied_party_check_status varchar [note: 'Result of the most recent denied party and sanctions screening check for the enterprise account group. Managed in Descartes Customs denied party screening module. Flagged accounts require compliance review before shipment execution.']
  effective_from date [note: 'Date from which the account hierarchy relationship becomes binding and operationally active. Used to manage time-bound corporate restructuring, mergers, and acquisitions in the customer master.']
  effective_until date [note: 'Date on which the account hierarchy relationship ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended relationships. Populated upon corporate restructuring, divestiture, or account termination.']
  erp_customer_hierarchy_code varchar [note: 'SAP S/4HANA Finance customer hierarchy node identifier for the account group. Enables reconciliation between CRM account structures and ERP financial hierarchies for consolidated billing and revenue recognition.']
  global_account_manager varchar [note: 'Name of the Transport Shipping global account manager responsible for the enterprise account hierarchy. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account ownership for escalation routing and relationship management.']
  hierarchy_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the account hierarchy relationship, used in Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA Finance for cross-system reference and consolidated billing linkage.']
  hierarchy_level varchar [note: 'Numeric depth of the child account within the corporate hierarchy tree, where level 1 represents the ultimate parent (global account). Enables multi-tier enterprise account navigation and reporting.']
  hierarchy_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable label for the account hierarchy relationship, typically reflecting the corporate group name (e.g., \'Acme Corp Global Group\'). Used in CRM dashboards and enterprise account reporting.']
  hierarchy_path varchar [note: 'Materialized path string representing the full ancestry chain from root to child account (e.g., \'/1001/2045/3087\'). Enables efficient tree traversal queries for enterprise account reporting and consolidated billing without recursive joins.']
  hierarchy_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the account hierarchy relationship. Controls whether the parent-child linkage is operationally active for billing consolidation, SLA management, and enterprise reporting.']
  hierarchy_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the purpose of the hierarchy structure. Corporate hierarchies reflect legal ownership; billing hierarchies drive consolidated invoicing; operational hierarchies manage service delivery; 3PL/4PL hierarchies manage logistics partner structures.']
  incoterms_code varchar [note: 'Default International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) applicable to the enterprise account group\'s shipments. Defines risk and cost transfer points for cross-border logistics. Sourced from SAP TM and Oracle TMS shipment configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  industry_vertical varchar [note: 'The primary industry sector of the enterprise account group (e.g., Retail, Automotive, Pharmaceutical, Technology, Energy). Used for vertical-specific SLA configuration, compliance requirements, and targeted service offerings in Salesforce CRM.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the account hierarchy relationship record. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer and audit trail compliance.']
  max_hierarchy_depth varchar [note: 'Maximum number of levels in the account hierarchy subtree rooted at this relationship node. Used for hierarchy validation, UI rendering optimization, and enterprise account structure governance.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional context, special instructions, or business commentary related to the account hierarchy relationship. Used by global account managers and finance teams for relationship management.']
  ownership_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of ownership or equity stake held by the parent account in the child account. Relevant for subsidiary and joint venture relationships. Used for IFRS 10 consolidation threshold determination and financial reporting.']
  payment_terms_code varchar [note: 'Standard payment terms code applicable to the enterprise account group (e.g., NET30, NET60, COD). Inherited by child accounts when consolidation is active. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance accounts receivable configuration.']
  pricing_inheritance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the child account inherits the contracted pricing, rate agreements, and GRI exemptions negotiated at the parent account level. Drives tariff application in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.']
  relationship_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the nature of the parent-child relationship within the account hierarchy. Drives how billing consolidation, SLA inheritance, and revenue roll-up are applied. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent|subsidiary|affiliate|regional_division|branch|joint_venture — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]']
  restructure_reason varchar [note: 'Business reason for the creation or modification of the account hierarchy relationship. Supports audit trail and change management for corporate restructuring events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: merger|acquisition|divestiture|reorganization|new_subsidiary|account_migration|other — promote to reference product if additional reasons are needed]']
  revenue_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the annual contracted revenue amount. Ensures consistent multi-currency financial reporting across global enterprise accounts.']
  revenue_roll_up_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the child account\'s revenue is rolled up to the parent account for enterprise-level P&L reporting and EBITDA analysis. Enables group revenue visibility in SAP S/4HANA Finance and CRM dashboards.']
  sla_inheritance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the child account inherits the SLA entitlements (e.g., OTD targets, OTIF commitments, priority service levels) from the parent account. Drives SLA enforcement and KPI reporting at the group level.']
  voting_rights_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of voting rights held by the parent account in the child entity. Determines control classification under IFRS 10 (control threshold typically >50%) for financial consolidation and regulatory reporting.']

  Note: 'Defines parent-child relationships within enterprise customer account structures, supporting multi-national corporate hierarchies, subsidiary relationships, and regional account groupings. Enables consolidated billing, group-level SLA management, and enterprise revenue roll-up across global accounts. Tracks hierarchy level, relationship type (parent/subsidiary/affiliate), effective dates, and consolidation flags.'
}

Table customer.shipper_profile {
  shipper_profile_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the shipper operational profile record in the customer domain. Primary key for the shipper_profile data product.']
  customer_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent customer account record that owns this shipper profile. Links the shipper operational defaults to the master customer identity.']
  default_origin_network_node_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: Shippers have default origin nodes for pickup operations. Essential for pickup scheduling, origin facility assignment, route planning, and network capacity management. Replaces denormalized address fi']
  edi_partner_id varchar [note: 'EDI interchange partner identifier (ISA qualifier + ID) used for automated shipment booking, ASN (Advanced Shipping Notice), and status message exchange between the shipper\'s systems and the TMS/WMS platforms.']
  exporter_trade_party_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Shipper profiles represent exporters in customs context. Required for: export declarations, AEO/CTPAT certification validation, denied party screening, and origin determination. Essential for outbound']
  preferred_carrier_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Shipper-level default carrier preference drives automated carrier selection in booking systems, rate shopping prioritization, and capacity allocation. Replaces denormalized preferred_carrier_code with']
  account_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the shipper account by business model. B2B for enterprise shippers, B2C for individual consumers, 3PL/4PL for logistics partners, NVOCC for Non-Vessel Operating Common Carriers, and government for public sector entities. Drives service tier and pricing logic.']
  aeo_certification_expiry date [note: 'Expiry date of the shipper\'s AEO certification. Used to trigger renewal alerts and to validate AEO status at the time of shipment booking in Descartes Customs.']
  aeo_certification_number varchar [note: 'WCO/EU-issued Authorized Economic Operator certification number. Certifies the shipper as a trusted trader, enabling simplified customs procedures and mutual recognition benefits across AEO partner countries.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the shipper profile record was first created in the system. Captured in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR data retention management.']
  credit_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum outstanding credit amount extended to the shipper for freight charges. Enforced during shipment booking to prevent over-limit tendering. Managed in SAP S/4HANA Finance accounts receivable.']
  ctpat_certification_expiry date [note: 'Expiry date of the shipper\'s C-TPAT certification. Monitored to ensure continuous compliance eligibility for US cross-border shipments.']
  ctpat_certification_number varchar [note: 'US Customs and Border Protection-issued C-TPAT certification number for the shipper. Indicates the shipper has met supply chain security standards, enabling expedited customs processing and reduced inspection rates.']
  default_currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the shipper\'s default billing and invoicing currency. Used in freight charge calculation, COD amounts, and SAP S/4HANA Finance revenue recognition.']
  default_incoterms varchar [note: 'Default Incoterms rule applied to shipments originated by this shipper. Defines the allocation of costs, risks, and responsibilities between shipper and consignee. Pre-populated on freight orders in SAP TM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]']
  default_packaging_type varchar [note: 'Shipper\'s default packaging type used for shipment booking and warehouse operations. Drives packaging material selection, DIM weight calculation, and stacking rules in Manhattan WMS and SAP TM.']
  eori_number varchar [note: 'EU-issued Economic Operators Registration and Identification number used for customs declarations and cross-border trade compliance within the European Union. Required for EU import/export filings in Descartes Customs.']
  hazmat_certification_expiry date [note: 'Expiry date of the shipper\'s hazmat handling certification. Shipments tendered after this date will be blocked from hazmat routing until recertification is confirmed.']
  hazmat_certification_number varchar [note: 'Regulatory certification or registration number authorizing the shipper to tender dangerous goods. Required for IMDG (ocean) and IATA DGR (air) hazmat shipments. Validated in Descartes Customs during shipment booking.']
  iata_shipper_code varchar [note: 'IATA-assigned shipper identification code used in air freight documentation including House Air Waybills (HAWB) and Master Air Waybills (MAWB). Required for IATA-regulated air cargo bookings.']
  is_cod_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Cash on Delivery (COD) is enabled for shipments from this shipper. When true, COD collection instructions are appended to delivery orders and ePOD workflows.']
  is_fragile_handling_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether shipments from this shipper require fragile handling by default. Triggers special handling instructions on freight orders and warehouse pick/pack operations in Manhattan WMS.']
  is_hazmat_authorized boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the shipper is authorized to tender hazardous materials shipments. When true, hazmat-specific handling, documentation, and carrier routing rules are applied. Validated against IMDG Code for ocean and IATA DGR for air shipments.']
  is_temperature_controlled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this shipper regularly tenders temperature-controlled (cold chain) shipments. When true, temperature-controlled handling, equipment, and carrier capabilities are applied by default in SAP TM routing.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the shipper profile record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and for audit trail compliance.']
  legal_name varchar [note: 'Full legal registered name of the shipper as it appears on Air Waybills (AWB), Bills of Lading (BOL), and customs declarations. Required for trade compliance and carrier documentation.']
  notification_channel varchar [note: 'Preferred channel for shipment status notifications and alerts (e.g., booking confirmation, ETA updates, POD). EDI indicates Electronic Data Interchange integration; webhook indicates API-based push notifications via FourKites or TMS integrations.']
  notification_email varchar [note: 'Primary email address for shipment status notifications, booking confirmations, and exception alerts. Used when notification_channel is set to email. Subject to GDPR consent management.']
  notification_phone varchar [note: 'Mobile phone number for SMS-based shipment notifications and alerts. Used when notification_channel is set to sms. Must be in E.164 international format.']
  payment_terms_code varchar [note: 'Standard payment terms code applicable to freight invoices for this shipper (e.g., NET30, NET60, PREPAID). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance customer master and used in freight audit and invoice processing.']
  preferred_load_type varchar [note: 'Shipper\'s default load consolidation preference. FTL (Full Truckload) and LTL (Less Than Truckload) apply to road freight; FCL (Full Container Load) and LCL (Less Than Container Load) apply to ocean freight. Used in load optimization in Oracle TMS.']
  preferred_service_mode varchar [note: 'Shipper\'s preferred primary transport mode for shipment booking. Influences carrier selection and routing logic in SAP TM and Oracle TMS. Multimodal indicates no single-mode preference.']
  profile_effective_from date [note: 'Date from which this shipper profile becomes operationally active and eligible for shipment booking. Supports time-bounded profile management and contract-aligned activation.']
  profile_effective_until date [note: 'Date after which this shipper profile is no longer operationally active. Null indicates an open-ended profile with no planned expiry. Used to enforce time-bounded shipper authorizations.']
  profile_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the shipper profile. Active profiles are eligible for shipment booking. Suspended profiles are temporarily blocked. Blacklisted profiles are permanently barred due to compliance violations or fraud. Drives booking eligibility checks in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.']
  salesforce_account_code varchar [note: 'Salesforce CRM Account object identifier for the shipper. Enables cross-system traceability between the operational shipper profile and the CRM account record for opportunity tracking, service cases, and customer communications.']
  sap_customer_number varchar [note: 'SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP TM customer master number for the shipper. Used for freight charge calculation, accounts receivable posting, and revenue recognition. Enables reconciliation between TMS and ERP financial records.']
  sla_tier varchar [note: 'SLA entitlement tier assigned to the shipper, determining priority handling, On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets, exception escalation thresholds, and dedicated account management levels. Sourced from Salesforce CRM contract records.']
  special_handling_instructions varchar [note: 'Free-text field capturing any additional special handling requirements for shipments from this shipper that are not covered by structured flags (e.g., \'Do not stack\', \'Keep upright\', \'Requires liftgate at delivery\'). Appended to freight orders in SAP TM.']
  tax_number varchar [note: 'Government-issued tax identification number (e.g., EIN in the US, VAT number in the EU, GST number in other jurisdictions) for the shipper entity. Used for customs declarations, freight invoicing, and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.']
  temperature_range_max_celsius decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-controlled shipments from this shipper. Used alongside the minimum to define the acceptable cold chain envelope for carrier and equipment selection.']
  temperature_range_min_celsius decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-controlled shipments from this shipper. Used to specify cold chain equipment requirements and validate carrier capabilities.']
  trade_name varchar [note: 'Operating or doing-business-as (DBA) trade name of the shipper, which may differ from the legal name. Used for customer-facing communications and account management in Salesforce CRM.']
  webhook_endpoint_url varchar [note: 'HTTPS endpoint URL registered by the shipper to receive real-time shipment event push notifications via webhook. Used when notification_channel is set to webhook. Must use HTTPS for security compliance.']

  Note: 'Operational profile for customers acting as shippers (origin parties) in logistics transactions. Captures shipper-specific attributes including default origin addresses, preferred service modes (air/ocean/road/rail), FTL/LTL/FCL/LCL preferences, carrier preferences, packaging requirements, hazmat handling authorizations (IMDG/IATA DGR), IATA shipper codes, C-TPAT or AEO certification references, default Incoterms, COD preferences, special handling instructions (fragile, temperature-controlled), and notification preferences (SMS/email/EDI/webhook). Serves as the unified operational defaults profile for shipment booking automation and personalized service delivery.'
}

  customer_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Consignee profiles represent customers acting in the consignee role. This FK links the operational consignee profile to the master customer account record. The consignee_profile table contains role-sp']
  delivery_network_node_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: Consignees have delivery location nodes for last-mile routing. Required for delivery scheduling, route optimization, last-mile zone assignment, and delivery promise calculation. Replaces denormalized ']
  edi_partner_id varchar [note: 'EDI interchange partner identifier (ISA qualifier + ID) for the consignee, enabling automated transmission of ASNs, delivery confirmations, and customs pre-arrival notifications.']
  importer_trade_party_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Consignee profiles represent importers/receivers in customs. Required for: import declarations, customs broker assignment, duty assessment, and delivery clearance. Critical for inbound customs operati']
  account_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the consignee profile. Blacklisted status is set by Descartes Customs denied-party screening. Pending verification indicates incomplete KYC or trade compliance checks.']
  aeo_certification_number varchar [note: 'AEO certification number issued to the consignee by the relevant customs authority, confirming trusted trader status. Enables expedited customs clearance and reduced inspection rates.']
  asn_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the consignee requires an Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) to be transmitted via EDI prior to shipment arrival. When True, ASN generation is triggered in the WMS/TMS integration layer.']
  consignee_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the consignee indicating the nature of the receiving party. Drives SLA entitlements, customs handling rules, and delivery workflows. B2B enterprise and 3PL/4PL partners are recurring; B2C individual may be one-time last-mile recipients. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: b2b_enterprise|b2c_individual|3pl_partner|4pl_partner|government|nvocc|freight_forwarder|broker — promote to reference product]']
  credit_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum outstanding credit amount extended to this consignee for duty deferment, freight charges on account, or COD (Cash on Delivery) waiver arrangements. Managed in SAP S/4HANA Finance accounts receivable.']
  ctpat_status varchar [note: 'C-TPAT membership status of the consignee as maintained in Descartes Customs. Certified status qualifies the consignee for reduced US CBP examination rates and expedited cargo release.']
  customs_broker_code varchar [note: 'Identifier of the licensed customs broker authorized by the consignee to handle import clearance on their behalf. Used in Descartes Customs for power-of-attorney validation.']
  ddp_authorized boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the consignee has authorized Transport Shipping to arrange DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) shipments on their behalf, where the shipper or carrier pre-pays import duties and taxes. Relevant for cross-border e-commerce fulfillment.']
  denied_party_screen_result varchar [note: 'Outcome of the most recent denied-party screening check. A match_found or blocked result prevents shipment processing until compliance review is completed.']
  denied_party_screened_at timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent denied-party screening check performed against this consignee in Descartes Customs. Required for trade compliance audit trails under US EAR, OFAC, and EU dual-use regulations.']
  epod_contact_email varchar [note: 'Dedicated email address to which electronic proof of delivery (ePOD) documents are transmitted upon successful delivery. May differ from the primary contact email when a separate receiving or logistics team handles POD acknowledgment.']
  epod_contact_phone varchar [note: 'Mobile or direct phone number for the ePOD recipient contact, used by drivers and last-mile couriers to confirm delivery and obtain digital signature authorization.']
  geo_latitude decimal(9,6) [note: 'GPS latitude coordinate of the consignee delivery location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used by FourKites for geofencing, last-mile ETA prediction, and proof-of-delivery geo-stamping.']
  geo_longitude decimal(9,6) [note: 'GPS longitude coordinate of the consignee delivery location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used alongside latitude for geofencing and route optimization in SAP TM and FourKites.']
  id_verification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the consignee must present government-issued identification at the time of delivery. Applicable for high-value shipments, controlled goods, or regulatory requirements.']
  import_license_number varchar [note: 'Government-issued import license or permit number held by the consignee, required for regulated or controlled goods categories. Validated during customs clearance in Descartes Customs GTM.']
  incoterms_preference varchar [note: 'Consignee\'s preferred Incoterms rule governing the transfer of risk and cost responsibility for import shipments. Incoterms 2020 standard. Drives duty and tax liability assignment in customs declarations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]']
  is_recurring boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this consignee is a recurring destination party (True) or a one-time recipient such as a B2C last-mile delivery addressee (False). Drives profile retention and SLA assignment logic.']
  legal_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the consignee as it appears on customs declarations, air waybills (AWB), and bills of lading (BOL). Used for trade compliance screening and import documentation.']
  notification_language_code varchar [note: 'IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the consignee\'s preferred language for shipment notifications, delivery alerts, and ePOD communications (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, zh-CN).']
  payment_terms_code varchar [note: 'Standard payment terms code applicable to this consignee for freight charges billed to destination (e.g., NET30, NET60, COD, PREPAID). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance customer master.']
  preferred_currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the consignee\'s preferred billing and invoicing currency for duty, tax, and freight charge settlements.']
  preferred_delivery_days varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of preferred delivery days of the week (e.g., MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI). Used by last-mile scheduling to avoid unattended delivery attempts and reduce failed delivery rates.']
  preferred_delivery_window_end varchar [note: 'Consignee-preferred latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour format) for delivery attempts. Defines the close of the acceptable delivery window for last-mile scheduling.']
  preferred_delivery_window_start varchar [note: 'Consignee-preferred earliest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour format) for delivery attempts. Used by last-mile routing engines in Oracle TMS and SAP TM to schedule delivery slots within SLA windows.']
  primary_contact_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the primary consignee contact used for shipment notifications, ePOD delivery confirmations, and exception alerts from FourKites visibility platform.']
  primary_contact_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the primary operational contact at the consignee location responsible for receiving shipments, signing ePOD, and coordinating customs clearance.']
  primary_contact_phone varchar [note: 'Primary telephone number for the consignee contact in E.164 international format. Used for last-mile delivery coordination and exception management.']
  profile_created_at timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the consignee profile record was first created in the Transport Shipping data platform. Represents the record audit creation event for lineage and compliance tracking.']
  profile_updated_at timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the consignee profile record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer and audit trail compliance.']
  requires_appointment boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the consignee requires a pre-scheduled delivery appointment before a driver can attempt delivery. True triggers appointment scheduling workflow in Oracle TMS.']
  salesforce_account_code varchar [note: 'External reference identifier from Salesforce CRM linking this consignee profile to the corresponding CRM account record for B2B consignees. Null for one-time B2C recipients.']
  signature_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a consignee signature is mandatory for proof of delivery (POD). When True, drivers must capture a digital signature via ePOD before completing the delivery event.']
  sla_tier varchar [note: 'SLA entitlement tier assigned to this consignee profile, determining delivery time commitments, exception handling priority, and OTD/OTIF performance targets. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account entitlements.']
  special_delivery_instructions varchar [note: 'Free-text field capturing consignee-specific delivery instructions such as dock number, gate access codes, forklift requirements, temperature-controlled unloading bay, or security check-in procedures.']
  tax_id_number varchar [note: 'Government-issued tax identification number (TIN, VAT number, EIN, or equivalent) for the consignee. Required for customs declarations, duty invoicing, and trade compliance filings in Descartes Customs.']
  time_zone varchar [note: 'IANA time zone identifier for the consignee delivery location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used to convert delivery window times to UTC for scheduling in SAP TM and FourKites.']
  trade_name varchar [note: 'Operating or doing-business-as (DBA) trade name of the consignee, which may differ from the legal name. Used for operational labeling and customer-facing communications.']
  warehouse_dock_number varchar [note: 'Specific dock door or bay number at the consignee\'s receiving facility. Used by drivers and Manhattan WMS for directed unloading and dock scheduling.']

  Note: 'Operational profile for parties designated as consignees (destination recipients) in logistics shipments. Stores consignee identity, delivery address preferences, customs clearance authorizations, import license numbers, preferred delivery windows, ePOD contact details, and special delivery instructions. Supports both recurring consignees (B2B) and one-time recipients (B2C last-mile). Distinct from shipper_profile as consignees have import-side compliance and delivery-side operational attributes.'
}

Business justification: Address book entries of type \'warehouse\' or \'distribution_center\' must link to actual facility records for dock scheduling, address validation, and facility-based shipment routing in transport logisti']
  network_node_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: Customer addresses map to network nodes for routing and planning. Powers address-to-node geocoding, route optimization, network design, and facility assignment. Essential for translating customer loca']
  address_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique business identifier or short code assigned to this address record, used in shipment booking, EDI transactions, and TMS integrations (e.g., SAP TM location code, Oracle TMS address code). Enables cross-system address referencing.']
  address_label varchar [note: 'Human-readable display name or alias for this address record (e.g., \'London Heathrow Warehouse\', \'NYC HQ Billing\', \'Shanghai Port CFS\'). Used in shipment booking UIs, ePOD systems, and customer-facing communications to identify addresses without displaying full address details.']
  address_line_1 varchar [note: 'Primary street address line including building number, street name, and any suite or unit designation. This is the first and most critical line of the physical address used on shipping labels, AWBs, BOLs, and customs declarations.']
  address_line_2 varchar [note: 'Secondary address line for additional location details such as floor number, building name, industrial estate, or complex name. Optional field used when the primary address line is insufficient to uniquely identify the delivery location.']
  address_line_3 varchar [note: 'Tertiary address line for additional location context such as district, neighborhood, or landmark reference. Commonly used in international addresses where additional geographic context is required for customs or last-mile delivery.']
  address_role varchar [note: 'Functional role this address plays in logistics operations. An address may be classified as an origin pickup location, delivery destination, billing address, return address, warehouse address, or notify party address. A single physical address may have multiple roles across different shipments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: origin|destination|billing|return|warehouse|notify_party — promote to reference product]']
  address_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the address record. Active addresses are available for shipment booking. Pending_validation addresses are awaiting address verification. Deprecated addresses are retained for historical reference but not available for new bookings. Blacklisted addresses are blocked due to compliance or fraud concerns.']
  address_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the physical address by its operational nature. Drives last-mile delivery rules, customs declaration requirements, and carrier surcharge logic. Residential addresses may attract residential delivery surcharges; port/airport addresses trigger terminal handling charge (THC) logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|commercial|warehouse|port|airport|border_crossing|free_trade_zone — promote to reference product]']
  aeo_certificate_number varchar [note: 'Official AEO certificate number issued by the relevant customs authority (e.g., EU EORI-based AEO number, C-TPAT account number). Required for customs pre-clearance, reduced inspection, and trusted trader benefits. Validated in Descartes Customs during shipment processing.']
  aeo_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the entity at this address holds Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification, which grants expedited customs clearance and reduced inspection rates. AEO-certified addresses enable simplified customs procedures and are prioritized in Descartes Customs trade compliance workflows.']
  city varchar [note: 'City or municipality name of the address. Used in route planning, carrier zone determination, customs declarations, and last-mile delivery assignment. Critical for TMS routing and freight rate calculation.']
  company_name varchar [note: 'Name of the company, organization, or business entity at this address. Required for commercial shipments, customs declarations, and B2B delivery. Used on shipping labels, air waybills (AWB), bills of lading (BOL), and customs documentation.']
  contact_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the primary contact at this address. Used for shipment notifications, electronic proof of delivery (ePOD) dispatch, customs pre-arrival notifications, and delivery exception alerts.']
  contact_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the primary contact person at this address. Used for last-mile delivery coordination, customs notifications, and proof of delivery (POD) capture. Required for residential and commercial delivery addresses.']
  contact_phone varchar [note: 'Primary telephone number for the contact person at this address, in E.164 international format. Used for last-mile delivery notifications, exception management, and customs clearance coordination. Required by many carriers for residential delivery.']
  country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the address (e.g., USA, GBR, CHN, DEU). Mandatory for cross-border shipments, customs declarations, Incoterms application, trade compliance screening, and international freight rate determination.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this address record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Provides audit trail for address master data governance, GDPR data subject access requests, and SOX compliance reporting.']
  customs_zone varchar [note: 'Customs and trade compliance zone classification for this address. Free Trade Zone (FTZ) and bonded warehouse addresses require special customs handling in Descartes Customs. Special Economic Zone (SEZ) addresses may have preferential duty treatment. Drives customs declaration routing and duty calculation.']
  dangerous_goods_permitted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether dangerous goods (DG) shipments are permitted at this address. When False, the TMS and booking systems will block DG shipments to/from this address. Governed by IMDG Code for ocean, ICAO Technical Instructions for air, and ADR/RID for road/rail transport.']
  delivery_window_close varchar [note: 'Latest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour format) when deliveries or pickups are accepted at this address. Used alongside delivery_window_open to define the acceptable delivery time window for route planning and SLA management.']
  delivery_window_open varchar [note: 'Earliest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour format) when deliveries or pickups are accepted at this address. Used by TMS route optimization to schedule delivery windows and ensure SLA compliance. Critical for warehouse and commercial addresses with restricted receiving hours.']
  effective_from date [note: 'Date from which this address record is valid and available for use in shipment bookings and logistics operations.   effective_until date [note: 'Date after which this address record is no longer valid for new shipment bookings. Null indicates an open-ended validity.
