  eori_number varchar [note: 'EORI number assigned by EU customs authorities to identify economic operators in customs declarations and trade transactions. Required for all import/export customs filings within the EU. Stored at the address level to support multi-site customers with different EORI registrations per facility.']
  facility_type varchar [note: 'Type of logistics facility at this address when applicable. Drives specialized handling requirements in Manhattan WMS, carrier selection in SAP TM, and customs processing in Descartes. Cold storage facilities require temperature-controlled transport; bonded warehouses require customs bond management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: distribution_center|cross_dock|cold_storage|bonded_warehouse|cfs|icd|airport_cargo|seaport_terminal — promote to reference product]']
  geocoding_accuracy varchar [note: 'Precision level of the geocoded latitude/longitude coordinates. Rooftop indicates exact building-level precision; range_interpolated is street-level; geometric_center is centroid of a postal area; approximate is city/region level; unverified means coordinates have not been validated. Drives confidence in GPS-based routing and geofencing.']
  hs_code_restriction varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of HS Code prefixes (Harmonized System codes per WCO) that are restricted or prohibited at this address due to local regulations, facility licensing, or trade compliance requirements. Used by Descartes Customs to flag non-compliant shipments during booking.']
  is_default_billing boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this address is the customer\'s default billing address for invoice generation and accounts receivable processing in SAP S/4HANA Finance. When True, this address is used for all financial documents unless overridden at the shipment level.']
  is_default_destination boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this address is the customer\'s default delivery destination. When True, this address is pre-populated as the destination in shipment booking workflows, supporting frequent lane customers and e-commerce fulfillment automation.']
  is_default_origin boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this address is the customer\'s default pickup/origin location for shipment booking. When True, this address is pre-populated as the origin in shipment booking workflows in SAP TM and Oracle TMS, reducing data entry errors.']
  is_residential boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this address is classified as a residential location. Residential addresses trigger carrier-specific residential delivery surcharges (e.g., FedEx, UPS residential fees), require different last-mile delivery protocols, and may affect SLA commitments for D2D (door-to-door) services.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this address record was most recently updated, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for change data capture (CDC) in ETL pipelines, optimistic locking in concurrent update scenarios, and audit trail compliance.']
  latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), ranging from -90 to +90. Used for GPS-based last-mile routing, geofencing in FourKites real-time visibility, proximity-based warehouse assignment, and route optimization in TMS.']
  longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), ranging from -180 to +180. Used alongside latitude for GPS-based routing, geofencing, real-time shipment tracking, and network design optimization in Blue Yonder.']
  postal_code varchar [note: 'Postal or ZIP code of the address. Used for carrier zone mapping, freight rate calculation, last-mile delivery routing, dimensional weight (DIM weight) zone surcharges, and address validation. Format varies by country.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this address record originated. Enables data lineage tracking, conflict resolution during master data synchronization, and audit compliance. Salesforce CRM is the primary source for customer-facing addresses; SAP TM and Oracle TMS for logistics locations.']
  source_system_address_code varchar [note: 'Native identifier of this address record in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce CRM Address ID, SAP TM Location ID, Oracle TMS Address Code). Enables bidirectional synchronization, change data capture (CDC), and cross-system reconciliation during EDI processing.']
  special_instructions varchar [note: 'Free-text field for special handling or access instructions at this address (e.g., \'Deliver to loading dock B\', \'Call 30 minutes before arrival\', \'Gate code: 1234\', \'No deliveries before 08:00\'). Transmitted to last-mile carriers and drivers via TMS dispatch notes.']
  standardized_address varchar [note: 'Full normalized and standardized address string as returned by the address validation provider, conforming to postal authority formatting rules. Used as the canonical address for printing on shipping labels, AWBs, and customs declarations to ensure deliverability.']
  state_province varchar [note: 'State, province, or administrative region of the address using ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes where applicable. Required for domestic routing, tax jurisdiction determination, and US/Canada customs filings (AMS, ISF).']
  timezone varchar [note: 'IANA timezone identifier for the address location (e.g., \'America/New_York\', \'Europe/London\', \'Asia/Shanghai\'). Used to correctly interpret delivery windows, calculate ETA/ETD in local time, and schedule last-mile delivery notifications across global operations.']
  validation_provider varchar [note: 'Name of the third-party address validation service or postal authority database used to validate this address (e.g., USPS, Loqate, SmartyStreets, Google Maps, HERE). Enables audit trail for address quality and supports provider performance benchmarking.']
  validation_status varchar [note: 'Result of the address standardization and validation process against postal authority databases (e.g., USPS, Royal Mail, Deutsche Post). Validated addresses have been confirmed deliverable. Failed addresses contain errors. Partial addresses are incomplete but usable. Used to enforce address quality gates in shipment booking workflows.']
  validation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the address was last validated against a postal authority or address verification service. Used to determine if re-validation is required based on address data freshness policies.']

  Note: 'Centralized repository of all customer-associated addresses including origin pickup locations, delivery destinations, billing addresses, and warehouse addresses. Supports address validation, geocoding coordinates, address type classification (residential/commercial/warehouse/port), and address lifecycle management. Used across shipment booking, last-mile delivery, and customs declarations to ensure address standardization.'
}

  lane_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: SLA entitlements are lane-specific contractual commitments. Required for lane-level performance monitoring, OTD/OTIF measurement by lane, penalty/incentive calculation, and contractual compliance repo']
  reporting_contact_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary customer contact who receives SLA performance reports and is the designated recipient for escalation notifications under this entitlement.']
  auto_renewal boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SLA entitlement automatically renews at the end of the effective period without requiring explicit renegotiation. When True, the entitlement rolls over under the same terms unless terminated.']
  claims_resolution_sla_days varchar [note: 'Maximum number of calendar days within which a cargo claim must be acknowledged, investigated, and resolved under this SLA entitlement. Drives claims team prioritization and escalation triggers.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this SLA entitlement record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Provides audit trail for record provenance and data lineage in the silver layer.']
  crm_entitlement_code varchar [note: 'Source system identifier for this SLA entitlement record in Salesforce CRM. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CRM system of record.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary fields in this SLA entitlement record (penalty_cap_amount, incentive amounts). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency customer accounts.']
  delivery_time_window_end varchar [note: 'Latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local time) by which delivery must be completed to be considered on-time under this SLA entitlement. Defines the close of the delivery window for time-definite commitments.']
  delivery_time_window_start varchar [note: 'Earliest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local time) within which delivery must be attempted to be considered on-time under this SLA entitlement. Used for time-definite delivery commitments (e.g., AM delivery windows).']

  entitlement_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the SLA entitlement. \'active\' means the entitlement is in force; \'suspended\' means temporarily paused (e.g., force majeure); \'expired\' means the effective period has lapsed; \'pending_activation\' means approved but not yet in effect; \'terminated\' means cancelled before natural expiry; \'draft\' means under negotiation.']
  escalation_threshold_hours varchar [note: 'Number of hours after a shipment misses its committed delivery time before an automatic escalation is triggered to the account management or operations team. Enables proactive exception management for high-value customers.']
  exclusion_conditions varchar [note: 'Free-text description of conditions under which SLA performance failures are excluded from penalty calculations, such as force majeure events, customs delays, natural disasters, consignee unavailability, or regulatory holds. Sourced from contract terms.']
  grace_period_hours varchar [note: 'Number of hours beyond the committed delivery time that are tolerated before a shipment is classified as a late delivery for SLA measurement purposes. Accounts for minor operational variances and is agreed upon at contract negotiation.']
  incentive_clause_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a financial incentive or rebate clause is in effect for over-performance against the SLA targets. When True, the incentive_rate_pct field defines the reward structure.']
  incentive_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the applicable freight charge or contract value awarded as a financial incentive or rebate for each percentage point of SLA over-performance above the committed target. Active only when incentive_clause_applicable is True.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this SLA entitlement record was most recently updated, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports change detection, incremental processing, and audit compliance in the Databricks lakehouse.']
  last_reviewed_date date [note: 'Date on which this SLA entitlement was last formally reviewed with the customer in a business review meeting. Used to track review cadence compliance and trigger upcoming review scheduling.']
  measurement_methodology varchar [note: 'Description of the methodology used to measure SLA performance, including how on-time is defined (e.g., first delivery attempt, POD scan time, ePOD timestamp), exclusions (e.g., force majeure, customs delays, consignee unavailability), and data source (e.g., FourKites, SAP TM, Oracle TMS).']
  measurement_period varchar [note: 'Frequency at which SLA performance is measured and reported against the committed targets. Determines the rolling window for OTD, OTIF, and volume threshold calculations.']
  min_volume_shipment_count varchar [note: 'Minimum number of shipments the customer commits to tender per measurement period to qualify for the SLA entitlement terms. Failure to meet this threshold may trigger tier renegotiation or penalty clauses.']
  min_volume_teu decimal(10,2) [note: 'Minimum volume in Twenty-Foot Equivalent Units (TEU) the customer commits to tender per measurement period. Applicable to ocean freight FCL/LCL services. TEU is the standard unit of container capacity measurement per IMO and FMC conventions.']
  min_volume_weight_kg decimal(18,3) [note: 'Minimum chargeable weight in kilograms the customer commits to tender per measurement period. Applicable primarily to air freight and express services where weight-based volume commitments are standard.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next formal SLA performance review with the customer. Derived from last_reviewed_date and review_frequency but stored explicitly to support scheduling and CRM activity management.']
  notice_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days advance notice required by either party to terminate or renegotiate this SLA entitlement before its effective_until_date. Governs contract exit obligations.']
  origin_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin geography of the lane covered by this SLA entitlement. Null if the entitlement is not lane-specific.']
  otd_target_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Contractually committed On-Time Delivery (OTD) rate expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Defines the minimum proportion of shipments that must be delivered within the agreed transit time window to meet the SLA. Core KPI for logistics SLA performance measurement.']
  otif_target_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Contractually committed On-Time In-Full (OTIF) rate expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Measures the proportion of shipments delivered both on time and with complete quantity/content as ordered. Stricter than OTD alone; commonly required by retail and e-commerce customers.']
  penalty_cap_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum financial penalty amount (in the contract currency) that can be levied against Transport Shipping in a single measurement period for SLA under-performance. Caps total financial exposure under the penalty clause.']
  penalty_clause_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a financial penalty clause is in effect for under-performance against the SLA targets. When True, the penalty_rate_pct and penalty_cap_amount fields define the financial exposure.']
  penalty_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the applicable freight charge or contract value applied as a financial penalty for each percentage point of SLA under-performance. Active only when penalty_clause_applicable is True.']
  pickup_cutoff_time timestamp [note: 'Latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local time) by which a shipment must be tendered for pickup to qualify for same-day transit under this SLA entitlement. Shipments tendered after this time are counted against the next business day for OTD measurement.']
  review_frequency varchar [note: 'Agreed frequency at which SLA performance is formally reviewed with the customer in a business review meeting. Drives scheduling of Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and account management activities.']
  service_line varchar [note: 'Business service line or product family to which this SLA entitlement applies, e.g., Express Parcel Delivery, Freight Forwarding, E-Commerce Fulfillment, Contract Logistics, Customs Brokerage. Aligns with the core business processes of Transport Shipping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express_parcel|freight_forwarding|supply_chain_mgmt|customs_brokerage|warehouse_distribution|ecommerce_fulfillment|last_mile|contract_logistics|cross_border — promote to reference product]']
  service_mode varchar [note: 'Transport or logistics service mode to which this SLA entitlement applies, e.g., Air Express, Ocean FCL, Road FTL, Road LTL, Rail, Parcel. Determines which operational processes are governed by this entitlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: air_express|ocean_fcl|ocean_lcl|road_ftl|road_ltl|rail|parcel|last_mile|warehouse — promote to reference product]']
  sla_tier varchar [note: 'Commercial tier classification of the SLA entitlement, reflecting the level of service commitment and associated pricing. Platinum represents the highest commitment level; standard represents baseline service.']
  transit_time_guarantee_days varchar [note: 'Maximum number of calendar days from shipment pickup to delivery guaranteed under this SLA entitlement. Defines the transit time window used to evaluate OTD compliance. Expressed in whole days; fractional-day commitments use transit_time_guarantee_hours.']
  transit_time_guarantee_hours varchar [note: 'Maximum number of hours from shipment pickup to delivery guaranteed under this SLA entitlement. Used for express and time-definite services where day-level granularity is insufficient (e.g., next-day AM, same-day delivery). Takes precedence over transit_time_guarantee_days when both are populated.']

  Note: 'Defines service level entitlements and volume commitments granted to a customer account, specifying OTD targets, OTIF commitments, transit time guarantees, pickup cut-off times, claims resolution SLAs, escalation thresholds, and minimum volume thresholds (TEU, kg, shipment count) by service line or lane. Captures SLA tier, applicable service modes, performance measurement methodology, penalty/incentive clauses for under/over-performance, measurement periods, and effective date ranges. Distinct from contract domain SLA templates — this is the customer-specific instantiated entitlement.'
}

Table customer.credit_profile {
  credit_profile_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the customer credit profile record in the Transport Shipping lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.']
  credit_analyst_employee_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Credit limit decisions require assignment to credit analysts for risk assessment and approval workflow. Regulatory requirement for financial controls and audit trail in freight forwarding operations.']

  ledger_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Credit profiles reference specific GL accounts (receivables control accounts) in the ledger for credit limit enforcement and exposure tracking. Credit controllers need to know which ledger account to ']
  approved_credit_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'The formally approved credit limit as of the most recent credit review, which may differ from the currently active credit_limit if a pending change is awaiting activation. Maintains the audit trail of the last approved value.']
  available_credit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Remaining credit headroom calculated as credit_limit minus outstanding_balance minus open_order_exposure. Stored as a business-critical operational field (not a derived KPI) because it is directly consumed by SAP TM shipment release checks and Oracle TMS load authorization gates.']
  billing_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which invoices are issued to this customer. May differ from credit_currency when the customer operates in a different functional currency. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance customer master.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this credit profile record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail start point required for SOX compliance.']
  credit_agency_name varchar [note: 'Name of the external credit reference agency that provided the credit rating or score (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Experian, Equifax, Coface, Euler Hermes). Required for audit trail and credit review documentation.']
  credit_agency_reference varchar [note: 'Unique reference number or DUNS number assigned by the external credit agency for this customer. Used to cross-reference credit bureau reports and validate the source of the credit assessment.']
  credit_control_area varchar [note: 'SAP organizational unit (credit control area code) within which this customer\'s credit limit is managed. Defines the scope of credit monitoring and aligns with the company code structure in SAP S/4HANA Finance.']
  credit_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit, outstanding balance, and exposure amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the customer\'s billing currency in SAP S/4HANA Finance.']
  credit_hold_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the credit hold was most recently applied to this account. Used for aging analysis of holds and SLA tracking for hold resolution.']
  credit_hold_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this customer account is currently under a credit hold, blocking the release of new shipments and freight orders in SAP TM and Oracle TMS. True = hold active; False = no hold. Operationally critical for shipment gating.']
  credit_hold_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code explaining why the credit hold was applied. Used by finance and operations teams to prioritize resolution actions and communicate with customers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overdue_invoices|credit_limit_exceeded|payment_dispute|bankruptcy_risk|manual_hold|compliance_review|other — promote to reference product]']
  credit_hold_released_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the most recent credit hold was lifted, allowing shipment release to resume. Null if the hold is still active. Used for hold duration analytics and finance KPI reporting.']
  credit_insurance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this customer\'s credit exposure is covered by a trade credit insurance policy (e.g., Euler Hermes, Coface, Atradius). True = insured; False = uninsured. Affects net credit risk exposure and provisioning under IFRS 9.']
  credit_insurance_policy_ref varchar [note: 'Reference number of the trade credit insurance policy covering this customer\'s receivables. Populated only when credit_insurance_flag is True. Used for claims processing and insurer reporting.']
  credit_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum approved credit exposure (in the credit currency) that Transport Shipping will extend to this customer at any point in time. Enforced by SAP S/4HANA Finance credit management to gate shipment release and invoice issuance.']
  credit_limit_approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee ID of the finance officer or credit manager who formally approved the current credit limit. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.']
  credit_limit_utilization_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the approved credit limit currently utilized, calculated as (outstanding_balance + open_order_exposure) / credit_limit × 100. Stored as a business-critical operational field consumed by SAP TM shipment release checks and finance dashboards — not a derived analytics KPI.']
  credit_rating varchar [note: 'External or internal credit rating assigned to the customer, using a standardized rating scale (e.g., S&P/Moody\'s-aligned: AAA through D, or NR for Not Rated). Drives credit limit approval tiers and risk-based pricing decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D|NR — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  credit_score varchar [note: 'Numeric credit score assigned by an external credit agency or internal scoring model, typically on a scale of 0–1000 or 300–850 depending on the agency. Used alongside credit_rating for granular risk segmentation and credit limit setting.']
  credit_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the credit profile. \'on_hold\' triggers shipment release blocks in SAP TM and Oracle TMS, preventing new freight orders from being executed until the hold is lifted by the finance team.']
  days_sales_outstanding decimal(10,2) [note: 'Average number of days taken by this customer to pay invoices, calculated from SAP S/4HANA Finance AR data. A key credit risk indicator stored as a business field (not a computed KPI) because it is sourced directly from the credit management system and used in credit limit decisions.']
  early_payment_discount_days varchar [note: 'Number of days from invoice date within which the customer must pay to qualify for the early payment discount. Paired with early_payment_discount_pct to define the discount window.']
  early_payment_discount_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage discount offered to the customer for early payment of invoices within a specified discount period (e.g., 2% if paid within 10 days). Defined in SAP S/4HANA Finance payment terms configuration.']
  effective_from date [note: 'Date from which the current credit terms (limit, payment terms, rating) became effective for this customer. Supports bi-temporal data modeling and credit history tracking.']
  effective_until date [note: 'Date on which the current credit terms expire and a review is required. Null for open-ended profiles. Triggers automated credit review workflows in SAP S/4HANA Finance when the date approaches.']
  insured_credit_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of the total credit limit that is covered by trade credit insurance. May be less than or equal to credit_limit. Used to calculate net uninsured exposure for IFRS 9 provisioning.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'Date of the most recently completed formal credit review for this customer. Used to determine review frequency compliance and trigger overdue review alerts.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this credit profile record, in ISO 8601 format. Required for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer and SOX audit trail.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next formal credit review of this customer account. Automatically calculated based on review_frequency_months from the last_review_date. Drives workflow triggers in SAP S/4HANA Finance.']
  open_order_exposure decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total value of freight orders and shipments that have been accepted but not yet invoiced, representing committed but unbilled credit exposure. Sourced from SAP TM freight order management and used in real-time credit checks.']
  outstanding_balance decimal(18,2) [note: 'Current total of unpaid invoices and open receivables against this credit profile, expressed in the credit currency. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance Accounts Receivable (AR) sub-ledger. Used to calculate available credit headroom.']

  payment_terms_code varchar [note: 'SAP S/4HANA Finance payment terms key (e.g., NT30, NT60, NT90, ZB14) defining the contractual payment due date schedule for invoices raised against this customer. Governs net 30, net 60, net 90, or early-payment discount structures.']
  payment_terms_days varchar [note: 'Numeric representation of the standard payment due period in calendar days (e.g., 30, 60, 90). Complements payment_terms_code for analytics, SLA reporting, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculations in the finance domain.']
  profile_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the credit profile, used in correspondence with credit agencies, billing teams, and finance operations. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance customer credit management (FD32).']
  profile_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the credit profile by customer segment: enterprise B2B accounts, small-to-medium enterprises (SME), individual B2C shippers, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) partners, Fourth-Party Logistics (4PL) partners, or government entities.   requested_credit_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Credit limit amount requested by the customer or proposed by the sales/account management team (Salesforce CRM opportunity data), pending formal credit review and approval by the finance team.']
  review_frequency_months varchar [note: 'Frequency in calendar months at which this customer\'s credit profile must be formally reviewed (e.g., 3, 6, 12, 24). Determined by credit risk tier: high-risk accounts reviewed quarterly, standard accounts annually.']

Table customer.customer_volume_commitment {
  customer_volume_commitment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the customer volume commitment record in the Transport Shipping lakehouse silver layer.']
  agreement_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the formal contract or agreement under which this volume commitment is governed. Links to the contract domain for legal terms.']
  budget_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Volume commitments drive revenue budgets and must be reconciled against budget targets for variance analysis and incentive/penalty calculations. Logistics companies use volume commitments to forecast ']
  carrier_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Volume commitments are typically carrier-specific (e.g., \'50K TEU/year with Maersk on Asia-EU\'). Procurement teams negotiate carrier-specific rates tied to volume; tracking actual vs. committed volume']
  crm_opportunity_id varchar [note: 'Salesforce CRM Opportunity record ID that originated or is associated with this volume commitment. Enables traceability from sales pipeline to operational commitment.']
  customer_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the customer account that has entered into this volume commitment agreement.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the internal employee responsible for managing this volume commitment and the customer relationship. Sourced from Workday HCM.']
  lane_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Volume commitments are lane-specific contractual obligations. Required for lane capacity planning, commitment tracking, volume variance analysis, penalty/incentive calculation, and contract compliance']
  target_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: High-volume customer contracts include contractual sustainability targets (e.g., \'reduce carbon intensity 15% over term\'), linking commercial volume commitments to measurable environmental performance']
  accrued_incentive_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Rebate or incentive amount accrued to date in the current measurement period based on current volume over-performance. Used for financial provisioning in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Expressed in currency_code.']
  accrued_penalty_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Financial penalty amount accrued to date in the current measurement period based on current volume shortfall. Used for financial provisioning in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Expressed in currency_code.']
  actual_volume_to_date decimal(18,4) [note: 'Cumulative actual volume shipped by the customer within the current measurement period as of the last data refresh. Expressed in volume_unit. Sourced from Oracle TMS shipment execution records.']
  alert_threshold_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Volume attainment percentage below which a performance alert is triggered for proactive account management intervention. Typically set above the penalty threshold to allow corrective action.']
  auto_renew boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this volume commitment automatically renews for the next period upon expiry without requiring a new negotiation cycle.']
  commitment_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name for the volume commitment agreement, e.g., \'FY2025 Asia-Pacific Ocean FCL Annual Commitment\'. Used for display and reporting purposes.']
  commitment_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text operational notes or comments regarding this volume commitment, such as negotiation context, special conditions, or account manager observations.']
  commitment_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this volume commitment, used in customer communications, invoices, and operational reporting. Sourced from SAP TM freight agreement numbering.']
  commitment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the volume commitment. Draft: under negotiation; Active: binding and in measurement period; Suspended: temporarily paused; Completed: measurement period ended; Cancelled: terminated before completion.']
  committed_volume decimal(18,4) [note: 'Minimum volume threshold the customer has contractually committed to ship within the measurement period, expressed in volume_unit. This is the baseline against which actual performance is measured.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this volume commitment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field aligned with SOX and GDPR data lineage requirements.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this commitment record (penalty_cap_amount, accrued_penalty_amount, accrued_incentive_amount).']
  destination_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination of shipments covered by this commitment. Combined with origin_country_code defines the trade lane.']
  effective_from_date date [note: 'Date from which this volume commitment becomes binding and volume measurement begins. Aligns with the contract period start.']
  effective_until_date date [note: 'Date on which this volume commitment expires and measurement ceases. Nullable for open-ended rolling commitments.']
  exclusion_conditions varchar [note: 'Free-text description of conditions under which volume shortfalls are excluded from penalty assessment, such as force majeure events, port strikes, natural disasters, or regulatory embargoes.']
  grace_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days after the measurement period end date during which the customer may still ship volume that counts toward the commitment, before penalty assessment is finalized.']
  incentive_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a financial incentive or rebate clause is active for this commitment when the customer meets or exceeds the target volume.']
  incentive_rate_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Rebate or discount rate applied to the qualifying volume to calculate the incentive amount. Expressed as a percentage of the contracted rate per unit.']
  incentive_threshold_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Minimum volume attainment percentage at or above which the incentive or rebate clause is triggered. For example, 100.00 means incentives apply when the customer meets 100% of committed volume.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent formal performance review of this volume commitment with the customer. Used to track review cadence compliance.']
  load_type varchar [note: 'Shipment load type classification for this commitment. FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less Than Container Load), FTL (Full Truckload), LTL (Less Than Truckload), parcel, or bulk. Determines how committed volume is measured and rated.']
  measurement_period_end_date date [note: 'End date of the current active measurement period. Used to determine the window for volume accumulation and variance calculation.']
  measurement_period_start_date date [note: 'Start date of the current active measurement period (e.g., Q1 start, month start). Distinct from effective_from_date which is the overall commitment start.']
  measurement_period_type varchar [note: 'Frequency at which committed volume performance is measured and evaluated against thresholds. Determines the cadence for penalty and incentive calculations.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next formal performance review of this volume commitment with the customer.']
  origin_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin of shipments covered by this commitment. Used for lane-level volume tracking and trade compliance reporting.']
  penalty_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a financial penalty clause is active for this commitment when the customer fails to meet the committed volume threshold.']
  penalty_cap_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum financial penalty amount that can be charged to the customer in a single measurement period, regardless of the shortfall volume. Expressed in currency_code.']
  penalty_rate_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Rate applied to the shortfall volume to calculate the financial penalty amount. Expressed as a percentage of the contracted rate per unit.']
  penalty_threshold_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Minimum volume attainment percentage below which the penalty clause is triggered. For example, 80.00 means penalties apply if the customer ships less than 80% of committed volume.']
  performance_alert_triggered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a volume under-performance alert has been triggered for this commitment in the current measurement period, prompting account manager intervention.']
  review_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which the volume commitment performance is formally reviewed with the customer. May differ from measurement_period_type (e.g., measured monthly but reviewed quarterly).']
  rollover_shortfall_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any volume shortfall from the current measurement period can be carried forward and offset against the next period\'s commitment before penalties are assessed.']
  service_line varchar [note: 'Specific service product line covered by this commitment, e.g., Express Parcel, Freight Forwarding, E-Commerce Fulfillment, Contract Logistics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express_parcel|freight_forwarding|ecommerce_fulfillment|contract_logistics|customs_brokerage|last_mile|supply_chain_mgmt — promote to reference product]']
  service_mode varchar [note: 'Transport mode to which this volume commitment applies. Determines the unit of measure and applicable rate structures (e.g., ocean uses TEU, air uses kg).']
  target_volume decimal(18,4) [note: 'Aspirational or stretch volume target above the committed minimum, used for incentive tier calculations. May equal committed_volume if no stretch tier is defined.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this volume commitment record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.']
  volume_attainment_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of committed volume achieved to date within the measurement period (actual_volume_to_date / committed_volume * 100). Used for performance dashboards and penalty/incentive trigger evaluation.']
  volume_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure used to quantify committed and actual volumes. TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit) for ocean FCL; kg for air freight; CBM (Cubic Meter) for LCL/road; shipment_count for parcel/express; ton for bulk.']
  volume_variance decimal(18,4) [note: 'Difference between actual_volume_to_date and committed_volume (actual minus committed). Negative value indicates under-performance; positive indicates over-performance. Expressed in volume_unit.']

  Note: 'Records of customer-committed shipping volume agreements specifying minimum volume thresholds (TEU, kg, shipment count) by service line, lane, or mode over a defined period. Captures committed volume, actual volume-to-date, variance, measurement period, and penalty/incentive terms for under/over-performance. Distinct from the contract domain\'s formal agreement — this entity tracks the operational volume performance against commitments.'
}

Table customer.carbon_enrollment {
  carbon_enrollment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the customer carbon offset program enrollment record. Primary key.']
  carbon_offset_program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the carbon offset program in which the customer is enrolled']
  customer_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the customer account that is enrolled in the carbon offset program']
  allocation_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of the customer\'s total carbon offset portfolio allocated to this specific program. Used to diversify sustainability portfolios across multiple program types (e.g., 50% forestry, 30% renewable energy, 20% direct air capture). Sum of allocation_percentage across all active enrollments for a customer should equal 100%.']
  auto_offset_enabled boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether automatic carbon offset retirement is enabled for this customer-program enrollment. When true, Transport Shipping automatically retires offset credits from this program based on the customer\'s shipment emissions and allocation rules. When false, offsets are retired manually or on-demand.']
  certification_requirements varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of sustainability certifications or reporting frameworks that this enrollment is intended to satisfy for the customer (e.g., CORSIA, CDP, SBTi, ISO 14064). Used to ensure program selection aligns with customer compliance needs.']
  contract_end_date date [note: 'The expiration or termination date of the contractual agreement for this enrollment. Null indicates an open-ended or evergreen enrollment. Used to manage contract renewals and program transitions.']
  contract_start_date date [note: 'The effective start date of the contractual agreement between the customer and Transport Shipping for participation in this carbon offset program. May differ from enrollment_date if the contract is signed in advance.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this enrollment record was created in the database.']
  customer_program_code varchar [note: 'Optional customer-specific reference code or identifier for this enrollment, used for the customer\'s internal tracking and reconciliation purposes.']
  enrollment_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the customer was enrolled in this specific carbon offset program. Marks the start of the customer\'s participation in this program.']
  enrollment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the customer\'s enrollment in this carbon offset program. Active indicates the enrollment is operational and offsets can be procured/retired. Suspended indicates temporary pause. Expired indicates contract_end_date has passed. Cancelled indicates customer-initiated termination.']
  last_retirement_date date [note: 'The date of the most recent carbon offset credit retirement transaction for this customer-program enrollment. Null if no retirements have occurred yet.']
  minimum_monthly_offset_tonnes decimal(18,2) [note: 'The minimum quantity of carbon offset credits (in tonnes CO2e) that the customer has committed to procure or retire from this program on a monthly basis. Used for capacity planning and procurement workflows.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional notes, special terms, or operational instructions specific to this customer-program enrollment.']
  pricing_tier varchar [note: 'The pricing tier applicable to this customer for this specific carbon offset program. Determines the per-tonne price the customer pays, which may differ from the program\'s base price_per_tonne_co2e based on volume commitments or enterprise agreements. Values: Standard, Volume, Enterprise, Custom.']
  total_tonnes_retired decimal(18,2) [note: 'Cumulative quantity of carbon offset credits (in tonnes CO2e) that have been retired from this program on behalf of this customer since enrollment. Used for sustainability reporting and customer dashboards.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this enrollment record was last modified.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the enrollment contract between customer_account and carbon_offset_program. It captures the commercial agreement by which a customer participates in one or more carbon offset programs to meet their sustainability commitments. Each record links one customer_account to one carbon_offset_program with attributes that define the terms of participation, allocation rules, pricing, and operational flags specific to that customer-program combination.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping\'s sustainability operations, customers actively enroll in multiple carbon offset programs simultaneously to diversify their sustainability portfolios, meet different certification requirements (CORSIA, CDP, SBTi), and offer flexibility in offset sourcing. Each carbon offset program serves multiple customers with individualized contractual terms, allocation percentages, pricing tiers, and operational configurations. The enrollment itself is a managed business entity with specific attributes (enrollment dates, allocation rules, minimum commitments, auto-offset flags) that belong neither to the customer account nor to the program, but to the relationship between them.'
}

Table customer.customer_program_enrollment {

Each record links one customer account to one compliance program with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In the logistics industry, customer accounts (B2B shippers, 3PL partners, etc.) actively enroll in multiple trade compliance programs simultaneously across different jurisdictions (e.g., C-TPAT in the US, AEO in the EU, ISO 28000 internationally). Each record links one customer account to one fulfillment center with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation relationship.. Existence Justification: In e-commerce fulfillment operations, customer accounts routinely use multiple fulfillment centers for geographic coverage, inventory distribution, and redundancy, while each fulfillment center serves multiple customer accounts. The business actively manages these allocation relationships with specific operational parameters: routing priority rules determine which center fulfills which orders, volume commitments govern capacity planning, customer-specific SLA terms define service expectations, and negotiated pricing varies by customer-center combination. This is not a derived analytical correlation but an operational business entity that fulfillment planners and account managers create, update, and query daily for order routing, capacity management, and billing purposes.'

Each record links one customer_account to one route_delivery_zone with pricing and service attributes that exist only in the context of this customer-zone relationship. This is the SSOT for zone-based pricing calculations, service promise validation, and customer-specific surcharge applicability used by rating engines, fulfillment systems, and customer service.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, enterprise customers negotiate zone-specific rates and service levels across multiple delivery zones based on their shipping volume and geographic footprint. Each customer-zone combination has unique pricing (zone_rate), surcharge waivers, guaranteed transit times, and service level commitments that cannot be stored on either the customer account (which has many zones) or the delivery zone (which serves many customers with different rates). This is an operational contract management entity actively maintained by account managers and pricing teams.'
}

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the air waybill record was first created in the source system (SAP TM). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 3-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this AWB are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, AED). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and CASS settlement.']
  declared_value_for_carriage decimal(15,2) [note: 'The value of the shipment declared by the shipper for the purpose of determining the carrier\'s liability in case of loss or damage. May be \'NVD\' (No Value Declared) in which case this field is null. Governs maximum liability per IATA conditions of contract.']
  declared_value_for_customs decimal(15,2) [note: 'The customs value of the shipment declared by the shipper for import duty and tax assessment at the destination country. Used by Descartes Customs for duty calculation and customs entry filing.']
  destination_airport_code varchar [note: '3-letter IATA airport code for the final destination airport where the cargo is to be delivered to the consignee (e.g., LAX, SIN, LHR). Used for routing, customs filing, and rate determination.']

  flight_date date [note: 'Scheduled departure date of the primary carrying flight. Used for booking confirmation, capacity planning, and ETD/ETA calculations.']
  flight_number varchar [note: 'The IATA flight designator code for the primary carrying flight (e.g., EK9301, LH8400). Used for shipment tracking, flight manifest reconciliation, and on-time performance reporting.']
  freight_charge_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Total base freight charge for the shipment calculated as chargeable weight multiplied by the rate per kg, in the billing currency. Represents the primary revenue line for the air freight service. Used for revenue recognition per IFRS 15.']
  gross_weight_kg decimal(10,3) [note: 'Total actual gross weight of the shipment in kilograms as declared by the shipper, including packaging and pallets. Used for load planning, aircraft weight and balance, and freight charge calculation.']
  hawb_number varchar [note: 'The House Air Waybill number issued by the freight forwarder or NVOCC to the individual shipper when consolidating multiple shipments under a single MAWB. Null when the AWB is a direct shipment not consolidated under a master. Sourced from SAP TM air freight module.']
  hs_code varchar [note: 'The Harmonized System commodity classification code assigned to the cargo, used for customs tariff determination, trade statistics, and import/export compliance. Minimum 6 digits per WCO standard; may be extended to 8 or 10 digits for national tariff schedules.']
  iata_airline_code varchar [note: 'The 3-digit IATA numeric airline prefix code identifying the issuing carrier (e.g., 176 for Emirates, 057 for Lufthansa Cargo). Forms the first segment of the MAWB number and identifies the contracting airline.']
  incoterms_code varchar [note: 'The ICC Incoterms 2020 code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between shipper and consignee (e.g., EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP).   is_dangerous_goods boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the shipment contains dangerous goods as classified under IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) and ICAO Technical Instructions. When true, additional DGR documentation and handling procedures are mandatory.']
  isf_filing_number varchar [note: 'The US Customs and Border Protection Importer Security Filing (ISF, also known as 10+2) reference number. Required for ocean and air cargo imports into the United States for advance security screening.']
  issue_date date [note: 'The date on which the air waybill was formally issued and signed, representing the principal business event timestamp for this contract of carriage. Corresponds to the execution date of the freight contract between shipper and carrier.']
  issue_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the air waybill was issued in SAP TM. Provides sub-day precision for operational sequencing and SLA measurement.']
  mawb_number varchar [note: 'The Master Air Waybill number issued by the airline or ground handling agent, formatted as the 3-digit IATA airline prefix followed by an 8-digit serial number (e.g., 176-12345678). Serves as the primary contract of carriage between the shipper and the airline. Sourced from SAP TM air freight module.']
  notify_party_name varchar [note: 'Name of the party to be notified upon arrival of the cargo at the destination airport, typically the customs broker or local agent. May differ from the consignee. Required for customs and airline notification purposes.']
  origin_airport_code varchar [note: '3-letter IATA airport code for the airport of departure where the cargo is tendered to the airline (e.g., DXB, FRA, JFK). Used for routing, rate determination, and regulatory reporting.']
  origin_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the goods were manufactured or produced. Required for customs declarations, preferential tariff determination, and trade compliance screening.']
  other_charges_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Total of all ancillary charges beyond the base freight charge, including fuel surcharges, security surcharges, terminal handling charges (THC), and special handling fees. Aggregated from the charges breakdown for billing purposes.']
  pieces_count varchar [note: 'Total number of individual pieces, packages, or handling units included in this shipment as declared on the AWB. Used for cargo acceptance, loading, and delivery verification.']
  pod_signatory_name varchar [note: 'Name of the individual who signed for receipt of the cargo at delivery, as captured on the electronic or paper proof of delivery (ePOD). Used for delivery confirmation and dispute resolution.']
  pod_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the cargo was confirmed as delivered to the consignee and proof of delivery (POD) was captured. Used for OTD measurement, SLA compliance, and triggering final invoice settlement.']
  rate_class varchar [note: 'IATA rate class code indicating the type of rate applied to this shipment (e.g., N=Normal, Q=Quantity, M=Minimum, B=Basic, C=Specific Commodity, E=Express, R=Reduced, S=Surcharge, U=Unit Load Device, X=Express). Determines the applicable tariff structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: N|Q|M|B|C|E|R|S|U|X — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  rate_per_kg decimal(10,4) [note: 'The agreed freight rate applied per kilogram of chargeable weight for this shipment, in the billing currency. Commercially sensitive pricing data used for revenue recognition and freight audit.']
  second_transit_airport_code varchar [note: '3-letter IATA airport code for the second intermediate transit/transfer point in the routing, if applicable. Null for direct or single-transit flights. Supports complex multi-leg air freight routing.']
  service_type varchar [note: 'The service level or product type for this air freight shipment (e.g., EXPRESS for next-flight-out priority, STANDARD for regular scheduled service, DEFERRED for economy/consolidation, CHARTER for full aircraft charter, COURIER for express parcel). Determines SLA commitments and pricing tier.']
  special_handling_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of IATA Special Handling Codes (SHC) applicable to this shipment (e.g., DGR=Dangerous Goods, PER=Perishables, VAL=Valuables, HUM=Human Remains, AVI=Live Animals, COL=Cold Chain). Drives handling instructions, storage requirements, and regulatory compliance checks.']
  total_charge_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Grand total of all charges on the AWB including base freight charge and all other charges (surcharges, fees, taxes). Represents the total amount due from the shipper or consignee. Used for invoice generation and accounts receivable.']
  un_number varchar [note: 'The 4-digit United Nations identification number for dangerous goods (e.g., UN1263 for paint, UN3480 for lithium ion batteries). Mandatory when is_dangerous_goods is true. Used for emergency response, handling, and regulatory compliance.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the air waybill record in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental loads, and audit compliance.']
  volume_cbm decimal(10,4) [note: 'Total volumetric measurement of the shipment in cubic meters (CBM). Used to calculate dimensional weight (DIM weight) and determine the chargeable weight when volume weight exceeds actual weight.']

  Note: 'Master document for air freight shipments serving as the contract of carriage between shipper and airline/freight forwarder. Stores MAWB and HAWB numbers, IATA airline codes, origin and destination airport codes, flight details, commodity description, HS codes, declared value, chargeable weight, freight charges, special handling codes (e.g., DGR, PER, VAL), and consignee/shipper details. Governed by IATA regulations. Sourced from SAP TM air freight module.'
}

  dwell_time_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Duration in hours that freight remains at the destination location before moving to the next leg. Critical for intermodal transfer efficiency and Service Level Agreement (SLA) monitoring.']

  leg_status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of this freight leg in its lifecycle. Tracks progression from planning through execution to completion.']

  sequence_number varchar [note: 'Sequential order of this leg within the multi-leg freight movement. Indicates the position in the transport chain (e.g., 1 for first leg, 2 for second leg).']
  service_type varchar [note: 'Type of freight service for this leg. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTL|LTL|FCL|LCL|express|standard|economy — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  temperature_controlled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this leg requires temperature-controlled transport (refrigerated or heated). Applicable for perishable goods, pharmaceuticals, and temperature-sensitive cargo.']
  teu_count decimal(10,2) [note: 'Number of Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU) for this leg. Standard measure of container capacity where a 20ft container equals 1 TEU and a 40ft container equals 2 TEU.']
  thc_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Terminal Handling Charge for this leg. Fee charged for handling containers at the origin or destination terminal.']

  total_leg_charges_currency varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total leg charges amount. Indicates the currency in which total leg costs are denominated.']
  transfer_type varchar [note: 'Type of intermodal transfer occurring at the destination of this leg.   transport_document_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the transport document for this leg. Can be an Air Waybill (AWB), Bill of Lading (BOL), House Air Waybill (HAWB), Master Air Waybill (MAWB), House Bill of Lading (HBL), or Master Bill of Lading (MBL) depending on mode.']

  vessel_name varchar [note: 'Name of the ocean vessel or aircraft used for this leg. Applicable for air and ocean transport modes.']
  voyage_flight_number varchar [note: 'Voyage number (for ocean) or flight number (for air) for this leg. Identifies the specific sailing or flight carrying the freight.']

  Note: 'Represents an individual transport segment within a multi-leg or intermodal freight movement, including intermodal transfer details at interchange points.   package_count varchar [note: 'Total number of packages, pieces, or handling units included in the quote.']
  packaging_type varchar [note: 'Type of packaging used for the cargo (e.g., pallets, crates, boxes, drums, bulk).']

Table freight.document_attachment {
  document_attachment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for this freight order to trade document attachment record. Primary key for the association.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the user who attached this trade document to this freight order. Used for audit trail and accountability.']
  freight_order_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the freight order that requires this trade document']
  reviewed_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the compliance or operations user who reviewed this document attachment for completeness and accuracy. Nullable if not yet reviewed.']
  trade_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the trade document attached to this freight order']
  acceptance_status varchar [note: 'Current status of this trade document attachment in the customs/regulatory acceptance workflow for this freight order. Drives clearance readiness and exception handling.']
  attached_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this trade document was first attached to this freight order in the system. Used for process timeline tracking and SLA monitoring.']
  customs_reference varchar [note: 'Reference number assigned by customs authority to this specific document submission for this freight order. Used for tracking clearance status and correspondence with customs.']
  document_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the trade document type attached to this freight order. Determines regulatory requirements and validation rules for this specific attachment.']
  rejection_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation provided by customs or regulatory authority for rejection of this trade document for this freight order. Nullable when acceptance_status is not REJECTED. Used for corrective action and resubmission.']
  required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this trade document is mandatory for customs clearance of this freight order based on origin/destination countries, commodity type, and incoterms. Drives compliance validation.']
  reviewed_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this document attachment was reviewed for this freight order. Nullable if not yet reviewed. Used for compliance workflow tracking.']
  submission_date date [note: 'Business date when this specific trade document was submitted to customs or regulatory authority for this freight order. Used for compliance tracking and clearance timeline monitoring.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential version number tracking revisions of this document attachment relationship. Increments when a document is resubmitted or replaced for this freight order. Enables audit trail of document corrections.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the attachment relationship between freight orders and trade documents in international logistics operations. It captures the specific documents required for each freight order, tracking submission status, acceptance by customs/authorities, version control, and rejection handling. Each record links one freight order to one trade document with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific attachment relationship, enabling full traceability of document compliance per shipment.. Existence Justification: In international freight forwarding operations, a single freight order requires multiple trade documents (commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificates, etc.) to satisfy customs and regulatory requirements across origin and destination countries. Conversely, in consolidation scenarios, a single trade document (such as a consolidated commercial invoice or master packing list) can cover multiple freight orders being shipped together. The business actively manages the attachment relationship, tracking submission dates, acceptance status by customs authorities, rejection reasons, and version control for each document-order pairing.'
}

Assigned indicates the agent has been nominated but not yet engaged, active indicates services are in progress, completed indicates services have been rendered, and cancelled indicates the assignment was revoked']

  service_scope varchar [note: 'The specific scope of services the agent is responsible for on this shipment. Values include origin_handling (pickup and export documentation), destination_delivery (import clearance and final delivery), customs_clearance (customs brokerage only), transit_coordination (intermediate handling), full_service (end-to-end), or documentation_only (paperwork without physical handling)']
  territory varchar [note: 'The geographic territory or location where this agent is responsible for servicing this shipment, typically expressed as a country code, city, port code, or region identifier']

  Note: 'This association product represents the service engagement between a freight order and an agent in the Transport Shipping partner network. It captures the operational assignment of agents to specific shipments for services such as origin handling, destination delivery, customs clearance, or transit coordination. Each record links one freight_order to one agent with attributes that define the scope, compensation, and territorial responsibility for that specific engagement.. Existence Justification: In international freight forwarding operations, a single shipment routinely requires multiple agents across different territories and service functions—an origin agent for pickup and export documentation, a destination agent for import clearance and final delivery, and potentially transit agents for customs or intermediate handling. Conversely, each agent in the network handles hundreds or thousands of shipments. The business actively manages these agent assignments with specific service scopes, territorial responsibilities, commission rates, and handling fees that vary by shipment characteristics and lane requirements.'
}

Table freight.carbon_allocation {
  carbon_allocation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the freight carbon offset allocation record. Primary key.']
  carbon_offset_program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the carbon offset program from which credits are allocated']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the user or system process that created this allocation record. Used for audit and accountability purposes.']
  freight_order_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to freight.freight_order.freight_order_id']
  order_freight_order_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the freight order receiving carbon offset allocation']
  allocation_date date [note: 'The business date on which the carbon offset credits were allocated from the program inventory to this freight order. Used for vintage tracking and accounting period assignment.']
  allocation_method varchar [note: 'The method by which the carbon offset program was selected and allocated to this freight order. AUTOMATIC indicates system-driven allocation based on availability and cost optimization; MANUAL indicates sustainability team override; CUSTOMER_SELECTED indicates customer-specified program preference; POLICY_BASED indicates allocation driven by corporate sustainability policy rules.']
  allocation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the carbon offset allocation. RESERVED indicates credits are allocated but not yet retired; RETIRED indicates credits have been permanently retired to the freight order; CANCELLED indicates allocation was reversed; PENDING indicates allocation is awaiting approval or payment.']
  allocation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the allocation record was created in the system, capturing the precise moment the credits were reserved or retired for this freight order.']
  customer_opt_in_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the customer explicitly opted in to carbon offset allocation for this freight order. True indicates customer-initiated carbon neutrality request; false indicates corporate default allocation policy applied.']
  program_tier varchar [note: 'The service tier classification of the carbon offset program selected for this allocation. STANDARD represents basic certified offsets; PREMIUM represents higher-quality offsets with co-benefits; GOLD represents top-tier offsets with verified additionality and permanence. Tier selection may be driven by customer preference or corporate policy.']
  quantity_tco2e_allocated decimal(18,4) [note: 'The quantity of carbon offset credits in metric tonnes CO2e allocated from this program to this freight order. This value represents the portion of the freight order\'s carbon footprint neutralized by this specific program allocation.']
  retirement_certificate_number varchar [note: 'The unique certificate or serial number issued by the carbon offset registry when credits are permanently retired for this freight order. Provides audit trail and proof of carbon neutrality claim.']
  total_allocation_cost decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total cost of this carbon offset allocation, calculated as quantity_tco2e_allocated multiplied by unit_cost_per_tonne. Used for cost accounting and customer billing when carbon offsets are a billable service.']
  unit_cost_per_tonne decimal(18,4) [note: 'The actual cost per metric tonne CO2e paid for this specific allocation, captured at the time of allocation. May differ from the program\'s listed price due to volume discounts, contract terms, or market fluctuations.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the allocation event between freight_order and carbon_offset_program. It captures the operational process of allocating carbon offset credits from specific programs to individual freight orders to neutralize their carbon footprint. Each record links one freight_order to one carbon_offset_program with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation transaction, including the quantity of CO2e credits allocated, allocation timestamp, allocation method, customer opt-in status, and program tier selection.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping\'s sustainability operations, a single freight order can have its carbon footprint offset by drawing credits from multiple carbon offset programs (e.g., splitting between a reforestation program and a renewable energy program to meet total offset requirements or customer preferences). Conversely, a single carbon offset program\'s inventory serves as a credit pool allocated across many freight orders over time. The allocation process is an operational business activity managed by the sustainability team, with each allocation carrying specific transactional data including quantity allocated, allocation date, method, customer opt-in status, program tier, cost, and retirement certificate details.'
}

  security_level varchar [note: 'Security classification of the storage location. High-value and bonded locations require additional access controls per Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) and Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) programs.']
  storage_location_level varchar [note: 'Vertical level or shelf position within the rack structure. Used for slotting optimization based on Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) velocity and weight.']
  temperature_class varchar [note: 'Temperature control classification of the storage location. Critical for cold-chain logistics and pharmaceutical shipments.']
  temperature_max_celsius decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum allowable temperature in Celsius for the storage location. Used for cold-chain compliance and quality assurance.']
  temperature_min_celsius decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum allowable temperature in Celsius for the storage location. Used for cold-chain compliance and quality assurance.']
  value_added_services_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this storage location is designated for value-added services such as kitting, labeling, repackaging, or customization operations.']
  volume_capacity_cbm decimal(12,3) [note: 'Maximum volumetric capacity of the storage location in cubic meters. Used for dimensional weight (DIM Weight) calculations and space optimization.']
  weight_capacity_kg decimal(12,2) [note: 'Maximum weight capacity of the storage location in kilograms. Used for slotting optimization and safety compliance.']
  width_cm decimal(10,2) [note: 'Physical width dimension of the storage location in centimeters.']

  Note: 'Granular storage location and zone master within a facility representing every bin, slot, rack, bay, aisle, floor position, and logical zone managed by Manhattan WMS. Tracks location code, zone assignment, zone type (receiving, bulk, pick-face, staging, dispatch, cold-chain, hazmat, quarantine, returns, VAS), aisle, rack, level, bin, location type, weight/volume capacity, temperature class, hazmat suitability, automation type, and current occupancy status. After merge with zone, also carries zone-level attributes (floor area, height, temperature range). Enables slotting optimization, directed putaway, and compliance segregation.'
}

  total_carton_count varchar [note: 'Total number of cartons or parcels packed for this wave. Represents the number of shippable units generated.']

  wave_allocation_method varchar [note: 'Inventory allocation strategy used for this wave. First In First Out (FIFO): oldest stock first. Last In First Out (LIFO): newest stock first.   wave_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text operational notes or special instructions for this wave. Used for communicating exceptions, special handling requirements, or coordination messages.']
  wave_number varchar [note: 'Business-facing unique wave identifier assigned by the Warehouse Management System (WMS). Used for operational tracking and communication.']
  wave_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the pick wave. Tracks progression from planning through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|released|in_progress|picking_complete|packing_in_progress|completed|cancelled|on_hold — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  wave_template_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the wave template or configuration profile used to generate this wave. Templates define picking rules, zone assignments, and resource allocation strategies.']
  wave_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the picking strategy used for this wave. Single-order: one order per picker. Multi-order: multiple orders picked simultaneously.   Note: 'Order picking and packing wave — a batch of outbound orders grouped and released together for coordinated pick-and-pack execution in the warehouse. Captures wave number, wave type (single-order, multi-order, zone, cluster, batch), release timestamp, planned/actual completion timestamps, total order count, total line count, total unit count, assigned zone, wave status, picker count, and associated packing station assignments. After merge with pack_order, also tracks carton/pallet consolidation, packed weight/CBM, packaging materials, and pack completion. Core orchestration entity for outbound fulfillment throughput.'

Table warehouse.cycle_count {
  cycle_count_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the cycle count event. Primary key.']
  approver_employee_id varchar [note: 'Employee identifier of the approver. Used for audit trail and accountability.']
  counter_team_id varchar [note: 'Identifier for the team or crew assigned to perform the physical count. Used for labor productivity tracking.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the warehouse or distribution center where the cycle count is performed.']
  zone_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to warehouse.zone. Business justification: cycle_count has zone_code (STRING) indicating which zone is being counted. Adding a proper zone_id FK enables JOIN to zone master for zone details. zone_code removed as it can be retrieved via the FK ']
  accuracy_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Inventory accuracy percentage for this count event. Calculated as (locations with zero variance / total locations counted) * 100. Key performance indicator for warehouse operations.']
  adjustment_posted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether inventory adjustments resulting from count variances have been posted to the WMS and financial systems.']
  adjustment_posted_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when inventory adjustments were posted to the system. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trail.']

  approver_name varchar [note: 'Name of the warehouse manager or supervisor who approved the cycle count results and variances.']
