  digital_trade_provisions boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement includes provisions on e-commerce, cross-border data flows, digital services, and prohibition of data localization requirements. True = digital trade provisions included; False = no digital trade provisions.']
  dispute_resolution_mechanism varchar [note: 'Summary of the dispute settlement procedures established by the agreement for resolving conflicts between member countries regarding interpretation or implementation (e.g., arbitration panels, joint committees).']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the trade agreement entered into force and became legally binding. Used to determine applicability of preferential duty rates.']
  environmental_provisions boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement includes commitments on environmental protection, sustainable development, and enforcement of environmental laws. True = environmental provisions included; False = no environmental provisions.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date when the trade agreement ceases to be in force. Nullable for open-ended agreements without a fixed termination date.']
  government_procurement_provisions boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement opens government procurement markets to suppliers from member countries on a non-discriminatory basis. True = procurement provisions included; False = no procurement provisions.']
  intellectual_property_provisions boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement includes chapters or provisions on intellectual property rights protection, enforcement, and cooperation. True = IP provisions included; False = no IP provisions.']
  investment_provisions boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement includes provisions on foreign direct investment protection, investor-state dispute settlement, and national treatment for investors. True = investment provisions included; False = no investment provisions.']
  labor_standards_provisions boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement includes enforceable labor rights and working conditions standards aligned with International Labour Organization (ILO) conventions. True = labor provisions included; False = no labor provisions.']
  last_amendment_date date [note: 'Date when the most recent amendment, protocol, or annex to the trade agreement entered into force.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this trade agreement record was most recently updated in the lakehouse. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent formal review or assessment of the trade agreement by member countries or the administering authority.']
  last_verified_date date [note: 'Date when the trade agreement details were last verified against official sources by Transport Shipping\'s trade compliance team. Used to ensure data accuracy for preferential duty rate calculations.']
  mutual_recognition_agreements varchar [note: 'Description of any mutual recognition agreements for conformity assessment, product standards, professional qualifications, or Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) programs included in or linked to the trade agreement.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next formal review or renegotiation of the trade agreement. Used for compliance planning and tariff rate updates in Descartes Customs GTM.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes, implementation guidance, or special considerations relevant to Transport Shipping\'s use of this trade agreement in customs declarations and duty calculations.']
  participating_countries varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing all member countries or customs territories party to the agreement (e.g., USA,CAN,MEX for USMCA).']
  product_coverage_scope varchar [note: 'Defines the breadth of goods and services covered by the trade agreement. All Goods = comprehensive coverage; Industrial Goods Only = excludes agriculture; Agricultural Excluded = industrial focus; Services Included = covers trade in services; Limited Product List = specific HS Codes only.']
  publication_reference varchar [note: 'Official publication citation or document reference number for the trade agreement text (e.g., treaty series number, official journal citation, UN registration number).']
  quota_provisions varchar [note: 'Description of any tariff-rate quotas (TRQs) or quantitative restrictions included in the agreement. Specifies product categories subject to quota limits and the preferential in-quota duty rates.']
  review_cycle_years varchar [note: 'Number of years between scheduled reviews or renegotiations of the trade agreement by member countries. Used to track when agreement terms may be updated or modernized.']
  rules_of_origin_criteria varchar [note: 'Summary of the origin determination rules required to qualify for preferential treatment under this agreement (e.g., change in tariff classification, regional value content percentage, specific processing requirements). Full rules are maintained in tariff_rate product.']
  safeguard_measures varchar [note: 'Summary of bilateral safeguard provisions that allow temporary suspension or modification of preferential treatment if imports cause or threaten serious injury to domestic industry.']
  signature_date date [note: 'Date when the trade agreement was formally signed by participating parties, prior to ratification and entry into force.']
  superseded_by_agreement_code varchar [note: 'Agreement code of the successor trade agreement that replaced this agreement, if applicable. Used to maintain historical lineage when agreements are renegotiated or replaced (e.g., NAFTA superseded by USMCA).']
  tariff_elimination_schedule varchar [note: 'Classification of the duty reduction timeline under the agreement. Immediate = zero duty on entry into force; Staged = phased reduction over specified years; Partial = some products excluded; Product Specific = varies by HS Code.']
  trade_agreement_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the trade agreement. In Force = active and applicable; Under Negotiation = being drafted; Signed Not Ratified = awaiting legislative approval; Suspended = temporarily inactive; Terminated = ended by parties; Expired = reached end date.']
  trade_facilitation_provisions varchar [note: 'Description of customs procedures simplification, advance rulings, single window systems, and other trade facilitation commitments included in the agreement to reduce border clearance times and costs.']
  wto_notification_number varchar [note: 'WTO Regional Trade Agreement notification number assigned when the agreement was notified to the WTO under GATT Article XXIV or GATS Article V (e.g., WT/REG123/N/1).']

  Note: 'Reference master for free trade agreements (FTAs), preferential trade arrangements, and customs unions applicable to Transport Shipping\'s trade lanes. Captures agreement name, agreement type (FTA/customs union/GSP/EBA/bilateral), participating countries, effective date, expiry date, key provisions (tariff elimination schedule, rules of origin criteria, cumulation rules), administering authority, and agreement status (in_force/under_renegotiation/suspended). Enables automated preferential duty rate lookup and origin criterion validation in Descartes Customs GTM.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|SUBMITTED|ACCEPTED|UNDER_EXAMINATION|RELEASED|REJECTED|AMENDED|CLOSED — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  risk_category varchar [note: 'Categorical risk classification assigned to this customs event. Used for prioritization and resource allocation in customs processing.']
  risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numerical risk assessment score assigned to this customs event by the customs authority or internal risk engine. Higher scores indicate higher risk requiring additional scrutiny.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SUBMISSION|ACCEPTANCE|EXAMINATION|RELEASE|AMENDMENT|REJECTION|APPEAL|CLOSURE|HOLD|CLEARANCE — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

  Note: 'This association product represents the participation relationship between compliance_program and company_code. Each record links one compliance_program to one company_code with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific enrollment.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping\'s global logistics operations, a single compliance program (e.g., C-TPAT, AEO) can cover multiple legal entities across different countries, and each legal entity typically participates in multiple compliance programs based on their operational jurisdictions and trade lanes. The business actively manages these enrollments as distinct operational records, tracking entity-specific certification status, audit schedules, compliance scores, and responsible employees for each program-entity combination.'

Table customs.trade_agreement_utilization {
  trade_agreement_utilization_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the customer account trade agreement utilization record. Primary key.']
  authorized_signatory_employee_id varchar [note: 'Employee identifier of the Transport Shipping customs specialist authorized to sign Certificates of Origin and preference declarations for this customer-agreement combination. Required for audit trail and compliance documentation.']
  customer_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the customer account that is utilizing the trade agreement for preferential duty treatment']
  trade_agreement_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the trade agreement being utilized by the customer account']
  annual_duty_savings decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total customs duty amount saved in the current calendar year by applying preferential rates under this trade agreement for this customer account. Calculated as sum of (standard_duty_amount - preferential_duty_amount) across all shipments. Expressed in USD equivalent.']
  certificate_count bigint [note: 'Total number of Certificates of Origin issued for this customer account under this trade agreement in the current calendar year. Used to track documentation volume and compliance activity.']
  compliance_audit_status varchar [note: 'Result of the most recent customs compliance audit for this customer-agreement utilization relationship. compliant = no issues found; minor_findings = documentation gaps that do not affect duty treatment; major_findings = issues requiring corrective action; non_compliant = preference claims suspended pending remediation; not_audited = no audit conducted yet.']
  first_utilization_date date [note: 'Calendar date when this customer account first claimed preferential duty treatment under this trade agreement. Marks the start of the utilization relationship.']
  last_audit_date date [note: 'Calendar date of the most recent compliance audit conducted for this customer account trade agreement utilization relationship. Null if never audited.']
  last_claim_date date [note: 'Calendar date of the most recent shipment for which this customer account claimed preferential duty treatment under this trade agreement. Used to identify dormant utilization relationships and trigger re-engagement campaigns.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for customs team to record special instructions, restrictions, or observations specific to this customer account trade agreement utilization relationship (e.g., specific HS code exclusions, product-specific origin requirements, customer-requested documentation preferences).']
  preference_eligibility_status varchar [note: 'Current eligibility status of the customer account to claim preferential duty rates under this trade agreement. eligible = account meets all origin and compliance criteria; conditionally_eligible = eligible subject to specific product restrictions or documentation requirements; ineligible = account does not meet agreement criteria; under_review = eligibility assessment in progress; suspended = eligibility temporarily revoked due to compliance issues.']
  total_shipments_claimed bigint [note: 'Cumulative count of shipments for which this customer account has claimed preferential duty treatment under this trade agreement since first utilization date.']
  utilization_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of eligible shipments under this customer-agreement combination for which preferential duty treatment was actually claimed. Calculated as (shipments_with_preference_claimed / total_eligible_shipments) * 100. Used to measure FTA adoption and identify optimization opportunities.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the operational utilization relationship between customer accounts and trade agreements in the Transport Shipping logistics network. It captures the active use of preferential trade agreements by customer accounts across their trade lanes, tracking duty savings realized, certificate of origin issuance, preference claim history, and eligibility status. Each record links one customer account to one trade agreement with metrics and operational data that exist only in the context of this specific account-agreement utilization relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, customer accounts actively utilize multiple trade agreements across their diverse trade lanes (e.g., a global shipper uses USMCA for US-Mexico shipments, CPTPP for Asia-Pacific routes, and EU-UK TCA for European lanes). Conversely, each trade agreement is utilized by multiple customer accounts. The business actively manages this many-to-many relationship through customs operations, tracking duty savings, preference utilization rates, certificate of origin issuance, and compliance status for each unique customer-agreement combination.'
}

EXW=Ex Works, FCA=Free Carrier, CPT=Carriage Paid To, CIP=Carriage and Insurance Paid To, DAP=Delivered at Place, DPU=Delivered at Place Unloaded, DDP=Delivered Duty Paid, FAS=Free Alongside Ship, FOB=Free on Board, CFR=Cost and Freight, CIF=Cost Insurance and Freight.   internal_notes varchar [note: 'Internal operational notes or comments about the surcharge definition, including implementation guidance, system mapping instructions, or historical context. Not visible to customers.']
  last_modified_by_user varchar [note: 'User ID or name of the person who last modified this surcharge definition. Used for audit trail and change management.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this surcharge definition record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.']
  maximum_charge_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Maximum surcharge amount that will be applied, capping the calculation result. Expressed in currency_code. Null if no maximum applies.']
  minimum_charge_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Minimum surcharge amount that will be applied, regardless of calculation result. Expressed in currency_code. Null if no minimum applies.']
  origin_country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for origin restriction. Null if surcharge applies regardless of origin. Used for lane-specific or country-specific surcharges.']
  per_unit_rate decimal(15,4) [note: 'Rate applied per unit of measure when calculation_method is per_unit. Unit of measure specified in unit_of_measure field. Null for non-per-unit surcharges.']
  percentage_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage rate applied to base freight when calculation_method is percentage. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Null for non-percentage surcharges.']
  priority_sequence varchar [note: 'Numeric sequence indicating the order in which this surcharge is applied when multiple surcharges are compounded. Lower numbers are applied first. Used to ensure correct calculation order (e.g., base freight → GRI → BAF → THC).']
  regulatory_mandate_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this surcharge is mandated by a regulatory body (true) or is a carrier-discretionary surcharge (false). Regulatory surcharges include security fees, customs processing fees, environmental levies.']
  surcharge_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the surcharge type. Fuel includes BAF; rate_adjustment includes GRI; terminal includes THC; seasonal includes peak season; security includes security fees; risk includes war risk and insurance; regulatory includes customs and compliance fees; operational includes handling and storage; accessorial includes special services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fuel|rate_adjustment|terminal|seasonal|security|risk|regulatory|operational|accessorial — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  surcharge_code varchar [note: 'Unique business identifier for the surcharge type (e.g., BAF, GRI, PSS, SEC, THC, WAR). Used across rate cards, spot quotes, and billing systems.']
  surcharge_description varchar [note: 'Detailed business description of the surcharge, including purpose, rationale, and any special conditions or exclusions. Used for customer communication and internal documentation.']
  surcharge_name varchar [note: 'Full descriptive name of the surcharge (e.g., Bunker Adjustment Factor, General Rate Increase, Peak Season Surcharge, Security Surcharge, Terminal Handling Charge, War Risk Surcharge).']
  surcharge_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the surcharge definition. Active indicates currently in use; inactive indicates not in use; pending indicates scheduled for future activation; expired indicates past effective_end_date; suspended indicates temporarily disabled.']
  trade_lane_scope varchar [note: 'Geographic scope of the surcharge applicability. Global applies worldwide; regional applies to specific regions (e.g., Asia-Pacific, Europe); country_specific applies to individual countries; lane_specific applies to origin-destination pairs.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for per_unit_rate calculation. KG=kilogram, LB=pound, CBM=cubic meter, CFT=cubic feet, TEU=twenty-foot equivalent unit, FEU=forty-foot equivalent unit. Applicable only when calculation_method is per_unit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|lb|cbm|cft|teu|feu|shipment|container|pallet — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of this surcharge definition, incremented with each modification. Supports change tracking and historical analysis of surcharge evolution.']

  Note: 'Master definition of all surcharge types applicable to freight and express shipments, including fuel surcharges (BAF), general rate increases (GRI), terminal handling charges (THC), peak season surcharges, security surcharges, and war risk surcharges. Captures surcharge code, surcharge name, surcharge category, calculation method (flat, percentage, per unit), applicable transport mode, trade lane scope, and governing body reference. SSOT for surcharge definitions used across rate cards and spot quotes.'
}

  region_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/region code where the index applies (e.g., USA, SGP, EUR). Used to localize fuel surcharge calculations by geography.']
  surcharge_tier varchar [note: 'Surcharge tier or bracket assigned based on index value or change percentage (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3). Maps to predefined surcharge rate tables.']

  Note: 'Periodic fuel price index records from external sources used to calculate and adjust BAF (Bunker Adjustment Factor) and fuel surcharges for air, ocean, and road freight. Drives automated surcharge recalculation cycles (typically monthly for ocean, weekly for road) and provides audit trail for fuel surcharge adjustments.'
}

  approved_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this dimensional weight rule was approved for use in production pricing systems.']
  commodity_type varchar [note: 'Type or category of commodity to which this dimensional weight rule applies (e.g., general cargo, perishables, high-value goods, dangerous goods).']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this dimensional weight rule record was first created in the system.']
  customer_segment varchar [note: 'Customer segment classification to which this dimensional weight rule applies, enabling segment-specific pricing strategies.']
  destination_country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO country code for the shipment destination to which this rule applies. Empty if rule applies globally.']
  destination_region varchar [note: 'Geographic region or trade lane destination classification to which this rule applies (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East).']
  dim_factor decimal(10,2) [note: 'Volumetric divisor used to calculate dimensional weight from package dimensions. Common values: 5000 for air freight (cm³/kg), 6000 for express (cm³/kg), 4000 for premium express. Formula: DIM Weight = (Length × Width × Height) / DIM Factor.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date from which this dimensional weight rule becomes active and applicable to shipment pricing calculations.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date on which this dimensional weight rule ceases to be active. Null if the rule has no defined end date.']
  incoterm varchar [note: 'International Commercial Terms code defining the allocation of costs and risks between buyer and seller, which may influence dimensional weight charge allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  is_default_rule boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this is the default dimensional weight rule applied when no more specific rule matches the shipment criteria.']
  length_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for package length dimension used in the dimensional weight calculation (centimeters, inches, or meters).']
  maximum_chargeable_weight decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum weight threshold above which the dimensional weight rule does not apply or special handling is required, expressed in the weight unit of measure.']
  minimum_chargeable_weight decimal(10,2) [note: 'Minimum weight threshold below which the dimensional weight rule does not apply or a floor chargeable weight is enforced, expressed in the weight unit of measure.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this dimensional weight rule record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional business notes, special instructions, or context regarding the application of this dimensional weight rule.']
  origin_country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO country code for the shipment origin to which this rule applies. Empty if rule applies globally.']
  origin_region varchar [note: 'Geographic region or trade lane origin classification to which this rule applies (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East).']
  packaging_type varchar [note: 'Type of packaging to which this rule applies (e.g., parcel, pallet, container, crate, envelope), as packaging affects dimensional weight applicability.']
  priority_rank varchar [note: 'Priority ranking used to resolve conflicts when multiple dimensional weight rules could apply to the same shipment. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.']
  rounding_method varchar [note: 'Method used to round the calculated dimensional weight to determine chargeable weight (round up to next whole unit, round down, round to nearest, or round half up).']
  rounding_precision decimal(5,2) [note: 'Precision to which the dimensional weight is rounded (e.g., 0.5 for half-kilogram increments, 1.0 for whole kilogram increments).']
  rule_code varchar [note: 'Business identifier code for the dimensional weight rule, used for external reference and system integration.']
  rule_description varchar [note: 'Detailed explanation of the dimensional weight calculation rule, including business context and application scenarios.']
  rule_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the dimensional weight rule for business user identification and reporting purposes.']
  rule_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the dimensional weight rule indicating whether it is actively applied in pricing calculations.']
  service_type varchar [note: 'Specific service type or product line to which this rule applies (e.g., Next Day Air, International Express, Standard Ground, Economy Ocean FCL).']
  transport_mode varchar [note: 'Mode of transportation to which this dimensional weight rule applies (air freight, ocean freight, road transport, rail transport, express parcel, or multimodal).']
  unit_system varchar [note: 'Measurement system used for dimensional weight calculation: metric (centimeters and kilograms) or imperial (inches and pounds).']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of this dimensional weight rule, incremented with each modification to support change tracking and audit requirements.']
  weight_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for weight used in the dimensional weight calculation and comparison with actual weight (kilograms, pounds, or grams).']

  Note: 'Dimensional weight (DIM weight) calculation rules defining the volumetric divisor and rounding conventions applied per service type, transport mode, and customer segment. Captures DIM factor (e.g., 5000 for air, 4000 for express), unit system (metric/imperial), rounding method, minimum chargeable weight, applicable service codes, and effective date range. Critical for revenue integrity in express parcel and air freight pricing where chargeable weight = max(actual weight, DIM weight).'
}

  Note: 'Negotiated contract-specific rate agreed with a customer under a service contract or rate agreement. Distinct from published tariffs and spot quotes — represents the binding commercial rate for a specific customer relationship. Feeds billing domain for invoice generation.'

Table pricing.rate_rule {

  origin_region_code varchar [note: 'ISO country or region code for shipment origin to which this rule applies. Null if rule is origin-agnostic.']
  priority_order varchar [note: 'Execution sequence number determining the order in which multiple applicable rules are evaluated and applied. Lower numbers execute first. Critical for cascading discount and surcharge logic.']
  proration_method varchar [note: 'Method for prorating charges when rule is applied mid-period or to partial volumes. Used for contract pricing and subscription-based logistics services.']

  rule_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the pricing rule describing its business purpose (e.g., \'Volume Discount - Asia Pacific FCL\', \'Peak Season Surcharge Q4\').']
  rule_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the pricing rule. Only active rules are executed by the rating engine during freight order charge calculation.']
  rule_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the pricing rule defining the category of rate adjustment logic applied. Determines which calculation engine module processes the rule in SAP TM.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record where this pricing rule was originally created and is maintained (e.g., \'SAP TM\', \'Oracle TMS\', \'Custom Rating Engine\').']
  threshold_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for minimum and maximum threshold values. Aligns with standard logistics units: TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit), CBM (Cubic Meter), weight units, or shipment count.']
  trigger_condition varchar [note: 'Business logic expression defining when the rule is applicable. May reference shipment attributes (weight, volume, TEU, origin, destination, service level, customer tier, commodity HS code). Evaluated by SAP TM rules engine.']
  updated_by varchar [note: 'User ID or name of the pricing analyst or system user who last modified this pricing rule record.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this pricing rule record was last modified.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version sequence number for this pricing rule. Incremented each time the rule is modified. Supports audit trail and rollback capabilities.']

  Note: 'Dynamic pricing rule defining automated rate adjustment logic, conditional pricing triggers, and business rules governing how rates are calculated or modified. Captures rule name, rule type (volume discount, lane-based adjustment, customer tier discount, peak surcharge, promotional rate), trigger conditions, adjustment type (flat, percentage, tiered), priority order, effective dates, and active status. Enables rule-based pricing engine execution in SAP TM charge calculation.'
}

Table pricing.rate_sustainability_contribution {
  rate_sustainability_contribution_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for this rate-target contribution relationship. Primary key.']
  contract_rate_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the contract rate that contributes to the sustainability target']
  target_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the sustainability target being supported by this contract rate']
  actual_emissions_tco2e decimal(18,4) [note: 'Actual cumulative emissions in tonnes CO2 equivalent for shipments under this contract rate since contribution tracking began. Updated at each measurement cycle.']
  baseline_emissions_tco2e decimal(18,4) [note: 'Baseline emissions in tonnes CO2 equivalent for shipments under this contract rate, measured in the target baseline year. Used to calculate reduction progress. Identified in detection phase.']
  bonus_rate decimal(18,4) [note: 'Financial bonus rate (in currency per tCO2e) awarded if emissions performance under this contract rate exceeds the target trajectory. Part of sustainability-linked pricing incentive. Identified in detection phase.']
  contribution_status varchar [note: 'Current status of this contribution relationship: active (rate is contributing to target), suspended (temporarily paused), achieved (target met), discontinued (rate no longer contributes).']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'Date on which this contract rate stopped contributing to the sustainability target. Null if contribution is ongoing.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'Date from which this contract rate began contributing to the sustainability target. May differ from the rate\'s own effective_start_date if sustainability tracking was added later.']
  incentive_amount_ytd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Year-to-date financial incentive amount (bonus or penalty) accrued based on emissions performance under this contract rate relative to target.']
  last_measurement_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent emissions measurement and performance assessment for this rate-target contribution.']
  measurement_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which emissions performance under this contract rate is measured and reported against the sustainability target (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual). Identified in detection phase.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, methodology adjustments, or business context for this rate-target contribution relationship.']
  penalty_rate decimal(18,4) [note: 'Financial penalty rate (in currency per tCO2e) applied if emissions performance under this contract rate fails to meet the target trajectory. Part of sustainability-linked pricing structure. Identified in detection phase.']
  performance_variance_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage variance between actual emissions performance and target trajectory. Negative values indicate better-than-target performance (emissions below target).']
  responsible_party varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the individual or team responsible for managing this rate-target contribution relationship and ensuring performance tracking.']
  target_contribution_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of the sustainability target that this contract rate is expected to contribute toward achieving (e.g., 2.5% of total Scope 3 reduction target). Identified in detection phase.']
  target_emissions_tco2e decimal(18,4) [note: 'Target emissions in tonnes CO2 equivalent for shipments under this contract rate by the target year. Represents the emissions reduction commitment embedded in this rate agreement. Identified in detection phase.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the contribution relationship between contract_rate and sustainability_target. It captures how specific negotiated contract rates contribute to corporate sustainability targets through modal shift incentives, low-carbon service adoption, and emissions reduction commitments embedded in customer agreements. Each record links one contract rate to one sustainability target with measurement and incentive attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In logistics sustainability programs, contract rates can be designed to contribute to multiple corporate sustainability targets simultaneously (e.g., a low-carbon ocean freight rate contributes to both Scope 3 Category 4 reduction targets and modal shift targets), and each sustainability target is achieved through the aggregated contribution of multiple contract rates across different customers, lanes, and service types. The business actively manages these contribution relationships with measurement cycles, performance tracking, and financial incentives (penalties/bonuses) tied to emissions performance.'
}

  Note: 'This association product represents the contractual assignment of a rate card to a customer account in the Transport Shipping logistics network. It captures which rate cards are active for which customers, with temporal validity, priority rules for overlapping cards, and scope restrictions by service mode and trade lane. Each record links one customer_account to one rate_card with attributes that exist only in the context of this commercial pricing relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, large enterprise customers are assigned multiple rate cards simultaneously based on different service modes (air vs ocean), trade lanes (Asia-Europe vs US-Domestic), and time periods (seasonal rates, contract renewals). Conversely, published tariff rate cards and segment-based rate cards apply to multiple customer accounts. The business actively manages \'Rate Card Assignments\' as a distinct operational concept with effective dates, priority rules for overlapping cards, and scope restrictions.'
}

Table route.lane {
  lane_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the origin-destination lane record. Primary key used across SAP TM, Oracle TMS, and Blue Yonder for rate lookup, carrier selection, and network optimization.']
  agreement_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the carrier or customer contract governing rates, SLAs, and operational terms for this lane. Links to the Contract and Agreement domain for rate lookup and charge calculation in SAP TM.']
  carrier_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary contracted carrier allocated to this lane for standard shipment execution. Used by SAP TM carrier selection engine and Oracle TMS for freight audit and load optimization.']
  contracted_carrier_service_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to network.carrier_service. Business justification: Lanes are often contracted under specific carrier service products with defined service levels. Required for rate application during quoting, service-level routing decisions, and contracted service va']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Lane operations (maintenance, monitoring, carrier management) are cost center activities. Required for network cost allocation and lane profitability analysis in logistics networks.']
  destination_location_network_node_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the destination network node (city, port, airport, ICD, CFS, or postal zone) at which this lane terminates. Paired with origin_location_id to define the directional transport corridor.']
  emissions_factor_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to sustainability.emissions_factor. Business justification: Lanes require emission factors for carbon footprint calculation per transport mode/fuel type. Standard requirement for customer-facing green logistics products and regulatory carbon reporting. Domain ']
  hub_gateway_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary intermediate hub or transshipment node in the hub-and-spoke network configuration for this lane. Null for direct point-to-point lanes. Used by SAP TM for route planning and load optimization.']
  lane_network_node_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the origin network node (city, port, airport, Inland Container Depot (ICD), Container Freight Station (CFS), or postal zone) from which this lane departs. Drives carrier selection and rate lookup in SAP TM.']
  profit_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Lanes serve specific profit centers (business units, geographic segments). Essential for segment P&L reporting and service line profitability analysis in transport operations.']
  template_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.document_template. Business justification: Lanes have standard document templates for country-pair specific forms, customs templates, and regulatory documentation. Real business process: lane configuration includes required documentation templ']
  aeo_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification is required for carriers or shippers operating on this lane. Enforced during carrier selection in SAP TM and compliance screening in Descartes Customs.']
  blue_yonder_lane_code varchar [note: 'External lane identifier assigned by Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning system for network optimization, demand forecasting, and inventory optimization workflows. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse and Blue Yonder.']
  co2e_emission_factor decimal(10,6) [note: 'Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emission factor in kilograms of Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) per tonne-kilometre for this lane and transport mode. Used for sustainability reporting under EU ETS, CORSIA, and GHG Protocol Scope 3 calculations.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this lane record was first created in the system of record and ingested into the Silver Layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance for master data change management.']
  destination_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the lane destination. Used for cross-border compliance, Importer Security Filing (ISF), and Automated Manifest System (AMS) reporting.']
  destination_unlocode varchar [note: 'United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations (UN/LOCODE) for the lane destination node. Used in EDI messages, Air Waybill (AWB), Master Bill of Lading (MBL), and Automated Manifest System (AMS) filings.']
  distance_km decimal(10,3) [note: 'Physical distance of the lane corridor in kilometres. Used for freight rate calculation, Dimensional Weight (DIM Weight) pricing, Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) emissions estimation, and network optimization in Blue Yonder.']
  distance_miles decimal(10,3) [note: 'Physical distance of the lane corridor in miles. Maintained alongside distance_km to support US DOT regulatory reporting and North American carrier rate negotiations where miles are the contractual unit.']
  edi_lane_code varchar [note: 'Lane identifier used in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) messages exchanged with carriers, customs authorities, and trading partners. May differ from internal lane_code due to carrier-specific EDI mapping requirements.']
  effective_from date [note: 'Date from which this lane definition becomes operationally active and available for shipment booking, carrier selection, and rate lookup. Supports temporal lane versioning in SAP TM and Blue Yonder.']
  effective_until date [note: 'Date on which this lane definition expires and is no longer available for new bookings. Null indicates an open-ended lane with no planned expiry. Used for lane lifecycle management and network re-optimization in Blue Yonder.']
  frequency_per_week varchar [note: 'Number of scheduled departures per week on this lane. Used for capacity planning, shipment booking availability, and On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance management. Sourced from carrier schedules in SAP TM.']
  ftz_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this lane passes through or terminates in a Free Trade Zone (FTZ), enabling duty deferral, bonded warehouse processing, or re-export without full customs clearance. Managed in Descartes Customs.']
  incoterms_code varchar [note: 'Applicable International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) governing risk and cost transfer on this lane. Determines customs brokerage responsibilities, insurance requirements, and freight charge allocation. Aligned with ICC Incoterms 2020. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  is_capacity_freeze boolean [note: 'Indicates whether capacity on this lane is frozen, preventing new load optimization allocations. Set by Blue Yonder during peak season planning or carrier capacity constraint events. Synchronized to Oracle TMS for load optimization.']
  is_cross_border boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this lane crosses an international border, triggering customs brokerage, Importer Security Filing (ISF), and trade compliance workflows in Descartes Customs. True for international lanes; False for domestic.']
  is_dg_permitted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Dangerous Goods (DG) shipments are permitted on this lane. False triggers a DG prohibition restriction. Governed by IMDG Code for ocean, ICAO Technical Instructions for air, and ADR for road transport.']
  is_embargo_active boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a trade or operational embargo is currently active on this lane, blocking new shipment bookings. Embargo status is managed in Descartes Customs and synchronized to SAP TM for carrier selection exclusion.']
  is_seasonal_closure boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this lane is subject to a seasonal closure (e.g., weather-related road closures, monsoon port restrictions). When True, the lane is excluded from carrier selection and route planning during the closure window.']
  lane_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the lane, used in SAP TM and Oracle TMS for rate lookup, freight order management, and carrier selection. Serves as the canonical cross-system reference key.']
  lane_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable descriptive name for the lane, typically formatted as origin-destination pair (e.g., \'Shanghai Port – Los Angeles Port Ocean FCL\'). Used in reporting, carrier communications, and network planning dashboards.']
  lane_status varchar [note: 'Current operational lifecycle status of the lane. Active lanes are available for shipment booking and carrier allocation. Suspended lanes are temporarily unavailable. Under_review lanes are pending network optimization assessment in Blue Yonder.']
  lane_tier varchar [note: 'Strategic tier classification of the lane based on volume, revenue contribution, and network criticality. Tier 1 lanes are high-volume strategic corridors; Tier 3 are low-frequency secondary lanes. Used by Blue Yonder for network optimization prioritization.']
  lane_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the lane by service category: express (time-definite premium), freight (standard bulk), last_mile (final delivery segment), cross_border (international), domestic (within-country), or multimodal (multiple transport modes). Drives SLA assignment and pricing tier in SAP TM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express|freight|last_mile|cross_border|domestic|multimodal — promote to reference product]']
  last_mile_zone_code varchar [note: 'Delivery zone code for last-mile operations at the destination, used for postal zone routing, delivery slot assignment, and Door-to-Door (D2D) service configuration. Applicable when lane_type is \'last_mile\'.']
  max_volume_cbm decimal(12,3) [note: 'Maximum allowable shipment volume in Cubic Metres (CBM) for a single consignment on this lane. Used alongside Dimensional Weight (DIM Weight) calculations for air freight rating and ocean FCL/LCL capacity planning.']
  max_weight_kg decimal(12,3) [note: 'Maximum allowable gross shipment weight in kilograms for a single consignment on this lane. Enforced during load optimization in Oracle TMS and freight order management in SAP TM. Derived from carrier and infrastructure constraints.']
  network_region varchar [note: 'Geographic network region grouping for this lane (e.g., Asia-Pacific, Europe, Americas, Middle East Africa). Used for network planning, capacity management, and regional P&L reporting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.']
  origin_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the lane origin. Used for customs compliance, trade restriction screening, and regulatory reporting to WCO and Descartes Customs.']
  origin_unlocode varchar [note: 'United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations (UN/LOCODE) for the lane origin node. Five-character code used in EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) messages, customs declarations, and Bill of Lading (BOL) documentation.']
  remarks varchar [note: 'Free-text operational notes or remarks about this lane, capturing special handling instructions, carrier-specific requirements, or network planning context not captured in structured fields. Used by operations and network planning teams.']
  restriction_authority varchar [note: 'Name of the regulatory body or internal authority that imposed the current lane restriction (e.g., \'IMO\', \'IATA\', \'US DOT\', \'WCO\', \'Internal Network Operations\'). Required for compliance audit and regulatory reporting.']
  restriction_effective_from date [note: 'Date from which the current operational restriction on this lane becomes effective. Used by SAP TM to exclude the lane from carrier selection and by Descartes Customs for trade compliance enforcement.']
  restriction_effective_until date [note: 'Date on which the current operational restriction on this lane expires and normal operations resume. Null indicates an indefinite restriction. Monitored by Blue Yonder for network re-optimization upon restriction lift.']
  restriction_type varchar [note: 'Categorical type of the most recently applied operational restriction on this lane. Used for exception reporting and compliance audit trails. Detailed restriction history is maintained in the lane_restriction event log.']
  sap_tm_lane_code varchar [note: 'External lane identifier from SAP TM (Transportation Management) used for route planning, freight order management, charge calculation, and carrier selection. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Silver Layer and SAP TM.']
  standard_transit_days varchar [note: 'Contractual standard transit time in calendar days from origin pickup to destination delivery for this lane. Used as the baseline for SLA compliance measurement, On-Time Delivery (OTD) KPI calculation, and Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) computation in FourKites.']
  transport_mode varchar [note: 'Primary mode of transport for this lane: air (IATA-governed), ocean (IMO-governed), road (DOT-governed), rail, or multimodal (combination). Determines applicable regulatory framework, carrier pool, and rate structure in Oracle TMS.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this lane record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  visibility_tracking_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether FourKites real-time GPS/IoT shipment tracking and predictive ETA calculation is enabled for shipments on this lane. Drives exception management and proactive customer notification workflows.']

  Note: 'Master origin-destination lane definition representing a directional transport corridor between two network nodes (city, port, airport, ICD, CFS, or postal zone pair). Owns the canonical lane identifier used across SAP TM, Oracle TMS, and Blue Yonder for rate lookup, carrier selection, and network optimization. Captures lane type (express, freight, last-mile), transport mode (air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal), lane status, standard transit time, distance (km/miles), lane tier classification, applicable Incoterms, operational restrictions (embargo, DG prohibition, seasonal closure, capacity freeze), restriction effective dates, and restriction authority. SSOT for all O-D lane master data referenced by pricing, freight, and shipment domains.'
}

Table route.network_node {
